Peter,

I'm pleased to share some great news in my campaign to serve as your representative in California’s 2nd Congressional District.

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzUui37tQKBCJoCg9rrf4iNYvfRSh3d4XsoEdaKKoOCPw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gop_marine_endorsements_230926&n=1)

Dear Friend, I'm pleased to share some great news in my campaign to serve as your representative in California’s 2nd Congressional District: The Sonoma County Republican Party and Marin County Republican Party have endorsed my candidacy! Earning the support of these organizations is an important milestone in our effort to prevail in the March primary and, ultimately, the November 2024 general election. I am grateful for this endorsement and the trust that it symbolizes. [**Your support is crucial to my campaign to bring leadership to California's 2nd Congressional District. Our first filing deadline is this Saturday, September 30th. Please chip in TODAY so I can continue fighting for parental rights, public safety, and our small businesses. Every dollar helps.**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKaqkTgx6xFw2eDwtCeuALv471PkYwvt9qx0xporMGb2A&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gop_marine_endorsements_230926&n=2) I will work to earn the support of citizens and organizations in our district. These endorsements will be the first of many over the coming weeks and months. Through your continued support, we will bring much needed change to the north coast and again make this a region where all residents have an opportunity to flourish. Sincerely, **Chris Coulombe**
Republican Candidate for California’s 2nd Congressional District [**P.S. We deserve a representative in Congress who prioritizes addressing the problems facing our communities, businesses, and families. My top priority will always be to serve the people of this district. Please contribute whatever you can to my campaign to restore leadership to the North Coast.**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKaqkTgx6xFw2eDwtCeuALv471PkYwvt9qx0xporMGb2A&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gop_marine_endorsements_230926&n=3)

| **Three Merced County Supervisors Endorse
John Duarte Congressional Campaign**
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 26, 2023
---
CONTACT: [Duane Dichiara](mailto:ddichiara@axiomstrategies.com?subject=%5BDuarte%5D)
(916) 997-4784
---
| | **MERCED, CA –** Today, three prominent Merced County Supervisors, Daron McDaniel, Lloyd Pareira, and Scott Silveira have endorsed John Duarte and his re-election campaign. John Duarte’s campaign for Congress continues to gain momentum as these community leaders have voiced their support and recognize his dedication to representing the interests of Valley families.

Congressman John Duarte expressed his gratitude for the endorsements, saying, “I am thankful to have earned an endorsement from Supervisors Daron McDaniel, Lloyd Pareira, and Scott Silveira. Their support reflects their trust and confidence in my commitment to serving the working families of the Central Valley. Together, we will work tirelessly to address the issues affecting our communities and promote a brighter future for our residents.”

Duarte continued, “These endorsements further highlight our campaign’s message of protecting the American Dream for hardworking Californians. I look forward to continuing to work with community leaders to lower the high cost of living, lower unaffordable prices, and to safeguard neighborhoods from rising crime.”

Please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=045f57766a&e=76a47b375f) for more information about the campaign.

I have exclusively confirmed that California Governor Gavin Newsom is meeting with Joe Biden in the Bay Area today. After speaking to a United Auto Workers (UAW) picket line in Michigan for only 87 seconds today (yes, really), Biden will be attending a fundraiser in Atherton, California which is just 100 miles from the State Capital of Sacramento, the home of Governor Newsom. **Socialism is the wrong prescription for Americans who want quality, affordable health care.**

If you believe this as I do, please don’t delay in submitting your opinion to be considered in urgent debates over socialized health care and your medical coverage.

You know the facts: that the Left’s extravagant “Medicare for All” plan would rob Americans of their choices, increase healthcare costs and end Medicare as we know it.

If you are frustrated by politicians who think more government is the answer to every problem, and who want to put your healthcare choices in the hands of Washington bureaucrats instead of your own doctor, we need your help today to stand firm against socialized healthcare.

Please use the link below to submit your opinions in our Ballot on Socialized Healthcare:

To fight socialism, we must expose the costs and dangers of government-rationed health care. So please don’t delay. Submit your ballot today:

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Help us take on Karine Jean-Pierre
body:
This White House has a terrible record of censoring journalists whose stories make the White House look bad.

| |
---
| | Friend, Joe Biden’s White House just changed the requirements for a journalist to obtain hard-pass credentials.The result... ...effectively banning our client, Simon Ateba, and more than 440 reporters from the White House Briefing Room.The White House is sending a loud, clear message: if you don’t work for CNN, _The New York Times_ , or another legacy media outlet, and if you refuse to mindlessly lob soft balls to Karine Jean-Pierre about Joe Biden’s ice cream du jour, you don’t belong in the White House Press Corps. Because this White House doesn’t respect the freedom of the press.**[Which is why I’m asking you for an urgent donation of $35 or more today to help fund Simon’s lawsuit against the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z67dj3f9rjhl2eac3lt5uv35gf6coj5dp80964p0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6aoj1clh2bs)** This White House has a terrible record of censoring journalists whose stories make the White House look bad.We all remember how the Biden Administration pressured “Big Tech” to censor journalists questioning the efficacy of the COVID-19 vaccine.Now, the White House is shifting its attention to our client, Simon Ateba. Simon Ateba is a journalist and White House correspondent with Today News Africa, a small a news organization focusing on ties and interactions between Africa and the United States.Simon frequently challenges Karine Jean-Pierre’s non-answers, inaccurate information, and demands transparency and the truth. In response to Simon’s insistence on getting the truth, the White House and Jean-Pierre changed the rules, I believe, to specifically target Simon and other journalists like him who want nothing more than to do their job as _real_ journalists.**That’s right – the White House rewrote the rules to shut out hundreds of hardworking reporters.** And that’s why we’re suing the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre on behalf of reporter Simon Ateba. **[Will you send an urgent donation $35 or more to the Center for American Liberty today to support our lawsuit on behalf of Simon Ateba and his fight for justice?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zca807gq70140i1rsufchcpo82l17onmetk36bqo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6aoj1clh2bs)** You and I know the White House’s actions here are a clear violation of the freedom of the press.This is bigger than Simon or any one journalist, Friend.Because the Biden Administration doesn’t just want to shut up Simon...... it wants to censor every journalist who challenges the White House’s lies, corruption, or abuse of power.We need your help right away.**[Which is why I’m asking you for an urgent donation of $35 or more today to help fund Simon’s lawsuit against the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2za989chd45co00sg5bfd2nrqdjro4e5ihss4iuv8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6aoj1clh2bs)****That’s why we’ve taken on Simon Ateba’s legal battle – and why I hope you will step up and help us win this important battle.** Simon needs you, our attorneys need you, and your country needs you.Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,

Harmeet K. Dhillon

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zcfb1ac636e5ictn47nqo8rgc6sios1nptk5o3a0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6ep72chh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmqg9icmigt8g2m07v32imj21laeqj4ocg20ottg_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6ep72chh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpac9c3nvo17lfi6fher3o548ej0u1181pr69omo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6ep72chh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmk4mmbig6u7gmpp1cvkem4so393oo4jg6c22ia8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g6ep72chh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Majorie Dannenfelser
subject: We desperately need your voice!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjip4i2uf35mihmroemnprpb3k169u5h2qtej3bo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o71c3h2bs)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjg9qggmjfp4se31bkdd9q772nd9a0dasl6i3j6g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o71c3h2bs)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.

[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9kj7s6kv47cpunutooea54lm6994sir4mu1af3o_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o71c3h2bs)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

body:

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zudgt6elmiggnehbtvc8fleuv8033q5r9edoc5q0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o75c5h2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdvgfa9nrm402uv8d8le0mda28fl9c8l0vd4gg88_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o75c5h2bs) [NO](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7ul06tk09dmv7ha5jtercnh0nsdidbob2krl1fo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o75c5h2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8s50mcdup7p5fj1un0fdkkf7j29aj62pkq74ejo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3g61o75c5h2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2l0CBFK9GxbEnZS8sgg5Tg&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America’s future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum ahead of the second debate in less than ONE WEEK!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23212%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2Xu1sj%2fADcw%2fNZaJhJY70g&sysid=1 "Once you’ve finished
reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s
momentum ahead of the second debate in ONE WEEK!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2l0CBFK9GxbEnZS8sgg5Tg&sysid=1)
---

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2l0CBFK9GxbEnZS8sgg5Tg&sysid=1)
---

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2l0CBFK9GxbEnZS8sgg5Tg&sysid=1)
---

Most importantly, I am running for president because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, at this very moment in time, **I’m about to hit a huge campaign milestone - my second Presidential Debate. [It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23213%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zfl13jPT51remd9%2bSXrZMQ&sysid=1 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show
the strength of my campaign before I take the stage. ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23214%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PvjW7yAOpBpRvZ6Xfk%2bC0w&sysid=1 "Will you consider making a
one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum
ahead of the debate next week?")**
---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23225%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WNA3odmY1h0O9N7QHwQxRg&sysid=1)
---
Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I’m hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help again- starting right now.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23226%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8J8SDlitawczQ1ECCwTyeA&sysid=1 "I need your help again
– starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23229%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YOeAfKeBMmn5zvbX7rPAPg&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23220%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sN6Cjpl7TVjUrwOLlKKIxA&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

name: Phil Kerpen
subject: ACTION ALERT: House PASSES bill to BLOCK California's internal combustion vehicle ban
body:
Dear Patriot,
Rep. John Joyce from Pennsylvania has introduced H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act, which would block California's proposed ban on internal combustion vehicles.
The bill passed the House last week.
[Please click here now to demand the Senate to pass H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act.](http://mgmail.americanpatriotdaily.com/c/eJx00D3WnCAUANDVaMnh8eTHwuLLmcw-UEFBURRkRlefk_Tpb3XHTo2tBFWbDkTLFQNKoZ47xXlvaIOj4GBaoMPI7GC1bbnuBYCuXccoQ9oyCciQUQJEUoq_G5DvH9H-QqGqhupgTjfoLep8uj2P2q03GfZQr92cc6zwp2Lvir3zqYeF_E__Nfj-5rXCF1i56TU8j5nvIHWzbSt312eSz5m_JR15P6zoBU93c-DyGQ6ujOjxEmBcjgG3BTifr0LlpumneMc0j885cX-UwH1maNViufd7Qb9LjUEM-_UYIY9RN_SkebdTikPFhHFzha_lCWpL2Yt4Bi_7-ZHJl7Ld6ZDY62muQycQmKDQ1mc3xo9bV5eErBo6Be3Wfx25-5IEQe-UALaRlGx9cKTkJs4TmbeoQBJlbpuIlc2IBPyFfwIAAP___XqQjA)
The automobile market is national and the global climate change issue is literally global. California's authority derives from a waiver the Biden administration granted them to set their own vehicle standards – despite the obvious adverse effect on interstate commerce.
H.R. 1435 amends federal law to prohibit the use of a Clean Air Act waiver to impose an internal combustion vehicle ban. This is critical for all Americans because the waiver allows California to set de facto standards for the whole country by forcing manufacturers to shift their production to electric vehicles.
Congressman Joyce is right to say, "California regulators shouldn't have the power to determine what vehicles are sold to families in Pennsylvania." That goes for every other state too.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zukr83dtafu9pa04kg17e58lavfh65rhfu5vc6go_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs)
---

Friend,

First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign's momentum ahead of the second debate in less than ONE WEEK!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6k0gkgj55092cvlp8351j03q7e6c9jq3d2j16r8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum ahead of the second debate in ONE WEEK!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3n724574m6cbt6bl7g1tco3p83bb9n6o8d3lpso_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs)
---

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z64q98il7hgeuo1bm106ar4jpcom3rrbo10anqk0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs)
---

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zptnfc48uhs7bhqvtumu4504kotovil88tuqlbe8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs)
---

Most importantly, I am running for president because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, at this very moment in time, **I 'm about to hit a huge campaign milestone - my second Presidential Debate. [It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5dt4femhroigig72pdvctlpgnf8rsn1q14ksro0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7licmrtdgdhc6nk3h2d3n87hhfm01r5h4b3slc8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?")**
---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgjnq3c68997rbn51np02ldq0opd3b2gch0cksd8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs)
---
Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help again- starting right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5h1k756mndrs81rnio183cqbcsroehfnill2478_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "I need your help again – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqbua26un0epi11308s6oib2g2lqiukbhtjnj5oo_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zu0h6po7sbbt5q3i4lj46pe9jjkqe80i193c8br8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3i64ob6chh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23247%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dsckGl46gq%2bXaFJb%2fQaHbQ&sysid=1)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23248%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OSSy7xWkikM9oLxAeKIHGg&sysid=1)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23249%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FAqdNW3yMTcz4oo2uE%2bOKQ&sysid=1)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
2776 S. Arlington Mill Dr.
PO Box 803
Arlington, VA, 22206

body:

# [Add your name to support ending the incarceration of girls like Sarah](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te6796eb1-278f-4086-a540-60c5a12a3398/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | When 13-year-old Sarah missed several school days, no one at school asked her why. If they had asked she would have told them that finding a place to sleep at night was more important than going to class. She would have told them about her troubles at home. She would have asked for help. **Instead, she was handcuffed and sent to court. ** [**Add your name if you support ending the incarceration of girls like Sarah.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc93f753-f307-4b29-8198-fbf5612f1e3b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) In the United States, most incarcerated girls are locked up on the false pretense that it’s for their safety and well-being—not because they pose any threat to the public. But correctional facilities are not designed with their safety in mind. Once behind bars, girls are subjected to solitary confinement, routine strip searches, and other forms of abuse. They are denied the mental health care, education, and social services they need. Far from helping girls cope with the trauma they have suffered, youth prisons re-traumatize them and push them farther away from society. [**Add your name if you support ending the incarceration of girls like Sarah.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a60c27c-809a-4568-9714-94d336395290/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: The Flyover
subject: GOP Debate Tonight, Wisdom From the Movies, and Skydiver Lands on Unicorn

## Second GOP Debate Missing Trump
The second GOP presidential debate [is tonight on Fox](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL9G6vDAIQQUFK9x59em1Bxw2JfBSJGwPfn7jFOn3NlmZz8uywW5crv-xzuFXtYFU-cnLdILsAL0AmMOhQhIjxTU7I1Ts5vceAs-lehmpBJ1hignZ6S1ORVVFNnJuJEDSNDSg5XeTAAn55BIzTp7aQDQDZOkzH3dT58rt36jUr_XJ-2ntN7HGm69b8eg_w1wHuCMW6PX8VZv2DunSgOcd9oesXLCJradDs7UOmMVmSJ2EiBhElQpdV6b-Hpg5cKURcKWOWOnQ5ApuhStvHYuZetkJFCzUUph1NLIcQ95e3GtfMx2mOT1jlx_E_vfx34CAAD__1bObHQ) from 9-11 p.m. ET, and the only change in the lineup is that Asa Hutchinson didn't qualify. Donald Trump, as before, chose not to participate. Ron DeSantis [will stand center stage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQAL_GdEZmzYFduHgN3b02JdrDa9jI2Ag7R-7vo0udcqQpRvNxn-_IkdP6H3dyNeQZl8pPmpWVMErQMzTeBSIg3ZDrBnsz3WB602zOEADpQHohC0T2MVodMAxdp8yIlhp2oEArC6Oytx6gNQaJukF7q24AaESvyHPNZ_uZOdWNQnzlJ53tkvcmuq3Wowj9T8AkYLquqw35-_FVOFEpb0fAdOTIlZciYPJUMFUuslRMntMqF0qVzjevJDeM9JIn7lgu3F8SkpdrPuRxUmFPqTJG6emBlZrT-ePiGLkMo-jVuiPH36j696OfAAAA__-1QWwz) for tonight's debate, flanked by Nikki Haley and Vivek Ramaswamy. Next will be Chris Christie and Tim Scott, and on the outer wings will be Doug Burghum and Mike Pence. All seven candidates are trailing Trump in the polls by a wide margin, and some strategists predict that at least one of the candidates will take on Trump directly to try and break out of the pack.
## Biden Joins Picket Line, Tells Union "Stick With It"
President Biden became the first president ever to [join striking autoworkers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSqyAUgOGn0Q4HDqhQUNzGLrfd0iF4jGdFcIDEydvvZOutv-af_-s23xwFio__7kBb1zQ7X-mFMzcMRgZyhnaxKyKgbNGKwfRaDFrpdrMIq-sRzOhl77gCvfTC371C0GYVKFqywEFyAyM3vQLotHaIYpCL4T2A043iuFBNuftOFOuGa3inF-bOp6MNdqv1LI3818DUwHRdVxfvPuJVPt7AdKZAlXz54EYV2ZaeBRuY7rRgZIfbsbCNSk35zUrNtFN8MPesiV0p75gLO8nvWFmgiCz76IQYpdJttst5UQhUhrFR_HE4Cr9R9e9HPwEAAP__-l9qgA) on a picket line, saying he endorsed the United Auto Workers demand for a 40% pay raise and urging them to "stick with it." Past presidents have [preferred not to take sides](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp_G7ohgMBgKituky223tPgZJ5MQYwFJtG-_8tbbfZ9Oc3S-LsvFU6bt-t8_0fW1LD52euPCLYOZgVxgTG5FBJQjOqGtMkKbyYw3F1PUAVCFFNCsU5A6cB0VhFlIYUGN5ICD5BZmbtUEcDLGIwotk-UKwJth4piol3q6F9r6Ddf8Xd5YT7E8x-xuve9tkP8GOA9w9vuGn3ag49ROMeMA571io4RbZ_eCLByTtV7pgey1UcfE_KsX9in1gbUxgzGaCTF6oaK1eparFCH5qC2IdQ5jdWn_UM7U9DxM_Pr0lH99-t95fgIAAP__hh1m5w) in order to have influence with both management and labor, but Biden's team wants to show union support ahead of today's visit to Detroit by Donald Trump, who will also speak to union workers. Trump won't join the picket lines but will speak at an event Wednesday night, just before the GOP debate. [He blames Biden's policies](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQxfGnMZ3ReAB_FC5uQ7e3TYkcPCwTGYzAu1bePiJ1un9xpJ90Ph7TI3Di_fk_bOTLkqcwF37TBE6ikdhN2ES_ECF1DXml3WCVtr1tVh-tHfSgUdnFmUVpPQe0YEKvQM2ArmGPgB04NOCGHrG1NhAp3UUHA2KwogeKXPLZfmXey0pL-s5vOts5b03yaynHJbp_AkeBY621PXLiwnO-BwLHneolcLwVgSO4u-8q52s75Mrlkp8caZd5l69Q5ZsvLhJAKWOcak4fj8op8aWN6OG5BU6_dPn7iZ8AAAD__wcGW8A) pushing electric cars as one of the causes of the strike.

## California Tops Sales Tax Rankings
A Tax Foundation analysis [ranks the ten states](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQAL8GOiy8YAMFxWvc3WtTWgTWhgibk1nd5f4-utSpphhppPm4rbdQajn3_-FAT1tbQ6TywFU6AUaAWoEnvyECKo5-nN1kx9lqy7MftQuYlI5x3oyLkwQDaBOCcZ-jNpEXDxKUdGCkmzTAYG1AHGeVnJwAgmVaYirUruGrlZMybvXVHngNsR28-kx070z9Y7AwWI524uttGCydAmEXuewZO4nanm-cTfRQsQsK3wwWfvl0f5ZaS58N03I_Qqm_afr79CcAAP__mchVDA) with the highest sales tax and the ten with the lowest, including five states that charge no sales tax at all.

Every state has a different policy on sales tax, which can range from zero to over 7%, and that's before adding in local sales tax, which can bring the total to as high as 12.65%. To see where your state falls, [here's a map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_G7ozMGowpXPzSL7pLmxLtwRocGYzw6i739hGRojSppphvpNH3fhtvGFPclzfcyHPII04cHzTqXkGnwIwgZx-IgIwkX9u-dbV1jZOrt-QmHe4zts5MNlDnjKPgTAuhvqPWMnrQYHQPne7bBqByDolqa-ZetwDoRKNpjpzP6iPHnVcK6ZUfdFZT3mTyK_NRhPknYBAwbHmn19UIGAojkyqYqCjGT3UiU1EbHhdqhpOCMP9_uKLWuKxUWKX8vGLPv1MBgzz9fDxjSrHYTjR62TCm7wv8t5GvAAAA__8rc2Kv) illustrating the level of sales tax in every state.

subject: I can’t say enough good things about Josh.
body:
House seat pickup

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T95af1c44-1f29-41c3-a58b-96e332c48ba1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, I got a favor to ask you. [My friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is running for Congress in NY-19, and his next FEC deadline is September 30. Will you join me right now by splitting a contribution of $20 or more between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7cd504a0-b8fa-46c5-b2bf-ffa384b67450/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tabf85a0d-f18f-450d-bec0-6e7cdb9d601f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I can’t say enough good things about Josh. Josh is the hardest working person I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. **Josh really cares about all the stuff I care about – and probably the stuff you care about too!**
---
|
---
| | | | | | [DONATE NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6802b0db-c751-48fa-abde-168883bef58b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| If that isn’t enough to convince you, NY-19 is a must-win for Democrats to take back the House. So this is pretty much the full package: a great candidate who will always do what’s right, and a big race we absolutely have to win. [Can Josh and I count on your support? The next big fundraising deadline of Josh’s campaign is coming up, and all eyes are on him. Please split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc3f3b78d-d40a-421a-b67d-7c9ce11d506c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks, Al **[PS - As you may know, I always end with a P.S. that’s just an excuse for another ask. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! body:

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66ec04c830dc403993f49f49f45f428a&_e=uIgVW4DLJOF5o2KB2HHpuNXPntv-bfCvFe2DKuoREx3Uwa2LL6ttfSW4g5o1Eg-GjlVU1kXeSswDlnGhbkLnrTYS3WMVQZOAr3-PARmz4HGkW0C2Fe6LfuZL1SDjuTjRdIOCsGvW02Z3jcMUDifZ85EjTBCpTfmeFoiCkMvkLq_0_ku1X4PSZuB45amXevuO3Bi3xMhT-iuhGYUd5jRFw52OaWhtQCYUyW4NlMy-MtcC1nNkvXyf15zMmT3gl2CUvyQVYBUg8APuXSaj-l7mbhKt66Epsz_KkJDqyR9nuznS7f8qtdq5MPHw6TPfr1C7PD-XTxnyyuPxA-UwxICVRjqWvb11ogbowFt3j5wFUvU%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=66ec04c830dc403993f49f49f45f428a&_e=uIgVW4DLJOF5o2KB2HHpuNXPntv-bfCvFe2DKuoREx3Uwa2LL6ttfSW4g5o1Eg-GjlVU1kXeSswDlnGhbkLnrTYS3WMVQZOAr3-PARmz4HGkW0C2Fe6LfuZL1SDjuTjRdIOCsGvW02Z3jcMUDifZ85EjTBCpTfmeFoiCkMvkLq_0_ku1X4PSZuB45amXevuO3Bi3xMhT-iuhGYUd5jRFw7gW5expH-R5b8sVOxh_hjWdorBLUckamVV9Es-jjWxWkiWBQ3R2AhwQ9DbRoOH_ctpkeebBZ3ha6dqV3itOJWYr25nEj1jUyV9CQbi5m4rW9K4h9n6iNsoVkn0-YDqlsVMU36bm0w5-620nP-Cgu88%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

| | A big challenge for these men and women is adjusting to civilian life after their military careers are over. Technically, counseling is “available” to them, but the offices are too far away to be practical. | | Peter,

This weekend I'm attending the [Global Health Freedom Summit](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=56efa23633&e=9828080a05). Digital tickets are now [absolutely free](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=0fe630e510&e=9828080a05), so I hope you'll [click here](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=a3a4f8ff20&e=9828080a05) and attend on Saturday. There is an outstanding [l](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=552cd0ec14&e=9828080a05)[ineup of health freedom speaker](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=5f24d779c5&e=9828080a05)s. In the meantime, I wanted to make you aware of two videos I put out this week.

The first video reveals big tech's illegal tracking of private citizens as well as big pharma’s never ending stream of revenue. We all need to be tuned in to what is going on in our country! [Click the thumbnail below](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=6d31953a2f&e=9828080a05), share the [video](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=a63dc6c5c9&e=9828080a05) and hold these people accountable:

| The next video was a recap of the so-called "experts" who used grossly-inaccurate COVID modeling and are too arrogant to admit that they may have made a mistake. Their "spin" shows a cunning character and lack of accountability in government. [You won't want to miss this one:](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=781b744e70&e=9828080a05)

| Minnesota and the country must wake up to the creeping tyranny coming back into society. In order to resist another round of COVID craziness, we have to learn from what we saw in 2020. Masking, forced social distancing, locking sick elders in nursing homes - it could ALL be back on the table if we're not vigilant.

It is readily apparent that Big Tech, Big Pharma, and Big Government - the triad of tyranny - are not interested in admitting they were all wrong. In fact, they seem willing to double down on these catastrophic policies.

It's for this reason, I'm imploring you: [attend the Global Health Freedom Summit on Saturda](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=6c7cfbc302&e=9828080a05)[y](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=5bd082e5ea&e=9828080a05) \- either in person or online. It is time to get serious about being engaged and educated on the next steps of those in power who push fear for their agenda.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Let Vivek hear from you before he steps on the debate stage. | | Fellow American, Vivek is ready to head into the second GOP Presidential Debate and continue to lay out his vision for a better America. I am so proud of him and this campaign and have never seen a harder-working candidate. One of the best things about Vivek is that he always takes time to have an open dialogue with the people he meets along the campaign trail - even those who may disagree with him. From a protestor at a town hall in Iowa who he was able to calm down and have a heartfelt conversation to a World War II veteran who praised Vivek's vision in New Hampshire saying, "what you're saying is 'exactly what my generation grew up in'" - meeting people like you is what keeps Vivek going. Tens of thousands of people are seeing the level of integrity Vivek represents and will bring to the Office of United States President. | When Vivek puts his mind to something, he gets it done. When he started this campaign, he had zero political experience and was at 0.0% in polling. Now, he's ranking among the top contenders and ahead of former governors, Vice President, and a sitting United States Senator. Exceeding expectations and delivering the TRUTH will always be his driving force. Fellow American, Vivek and our team need your help. Thank you for being a part of Team Vivek and let's carry this success into the next debate! Thank you, Apoorva Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5c32c3eb31d248db873e82f553f38f2d&_e=oAyfySw0iUn3MXvNd1vgVi8_FQuy_VN7zVBG3Z_MG3VbiYzLJm80WnL_Uo6Vfoodw3wVqzyVQ7xQnYdCpVe3-9WpLk1svZLTutp_XhLw81oIbq7Y7sA5EA4rR6NiloAwcCER0oZAinUt6kzHLBiyh86CI9KCgI2a2agmNpopp8I01OPb2GSgS5_ki6ZjvfNM0dRUjSvsZuYMmBDZfBOaDATEc_ap9Gn9QR_omUBP-4CaoZUOuYGUmowiBv2TTrKTpFv2uIj8Ygdd7SJkQLBgtWnJ5mYk34FKoowenlu3a5o9M6vrB5bV8oDZw9Oyzy_bZ3v6y_sRtDhGQjAIxsF4R0ERJhPLzU9NNOufFuZw3E0%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5c32c3eb31d248db873e82f553f38f2d&_e=oAyfySw0iUn3MXvNd1vgVi8_FQuy_VN7zVBG3Z_MG3VbiYzLJm80WnL_Uo6Vfoodw3wVqzyVQ7xQnYdCpVe3-9WpLk1svZLTutp_XhLw81oIbq7Y7sA5EA4rR6NiloAwcCER0oZAinUt6kzHLBiyh86CI9KCgI2a2agmNpopp8I01OPb2GSgS5_ki6ZjvfNM0dRUjSvsZuYMmBDZfBOaDH0sN2bfYrF06YboIe4Ri_SlRY8PikfpzktSYKF8bUkTI1yG--xKsxf9WyLr_iRQb5VveJoX1CigOVHQBwGVaLkHhriK6AL5lPuNzuf_ujSVDio0lzgBXn1BZJga9Fj1Dxqlp0oUWKglv9O87iDnAaE%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=38b29407e6514b688f4324f603469258&_e=fAoRuqiijWOVTlCdVoTKTc0rboMP6vSIYxvijz0jU-z0gaKhnSZtWcDTY-HpLls4OFju0-pvpYI2BbMPaDUbe9Ecuo4XNEys0TFwCN-uJCsIPjaslw4f1XJfRFVqRC0d6dh9szFHbX6hBLvm34uTB3E3UUcUgvlZh52P8hDdhWbvZM625WcZ8PnBeyE0I0y_dxwP4tJ_qqw4Gw2FXMcDrXsCfa8WnT_MgU-V0HbtdQTJdIEDqsekp9umlcMgHV4mMT0GlTl2XkqjISzI0r8nkI4NTXh726Ut9AfBlKznEqJUyrCCGRdc39YX3cLwfFwWgd1IoxPNf_SWEl0jb6JVxZXx7EDCqP3C7POVIUG7W9__I3-bk7fKJDDrcCZ7va2T_8Xkz1-mgbhnhP3bxU6z8Q%3D%3D)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=38b29407e6514b688f4324f603469258&_e=fAoRuqiijWOVTlCdVoTKTc0rboMP6vSIYxvijz0jU-z0gaKhnSZtWcDTY-HpLls4OFju0-pvpYI2BbMPaDUbe9Ecuo4XNEys0TFwCN-uJCsIPjaslw4f1XJfRFVqRC0d6dh9szFHbX6hBLvm34uTB3E3UUcUgvlZh52P8hDdhWbvZM625WcZ8PnBeyE0I0y_dxwP4tJ_qqw4Gw2FXMcDrXsCfa8WnT_MgU-V0HbtdQTJdIEDqsekp9umlcMgHV4mk0d1rSJy3-Swu27QgBpJDdINzEweGZF2tnmm5tFkg9j98iAej4YS9541esEYmQEwKe2UayR6rEHT4CeaSWY119KvNIlKGwSmmLGjjqmTR9fF6Tg5gnRjWnuwlcD8llGngc3RVQsHnMy535rHSE9Adg%3D%3D)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**

clean_body: Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children? %recipient.md5hash% | Pro-Life Advocate, I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected. I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion. I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion. The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events. | I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. | Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=096d364eb9404c0fa05e99a94836a017&_e=nQLuob7rC3vfRkrdMt906MQRXphNP9SJxRh5V5F_1PTo2beP1tK-CPsaf0t6dvjawXakdiBKHpsA7uZDNo5d-I0LYNEOYCvcsnbOGRfUBJjJtOlnNM94bWFIIGcF20jiHFgXM2Ew_l6hULKKmORBiNa6x1zywUc0q2nObIjbut9hhyqCm9NFNXVZr6CiA5eieQCEHp_uSZkoBvtvWTfu-mwy4yOGgWLBvNLDS0TX-x2PkwGpj2Nbfv7u2TJroV_1um0sywm-2QjLCXhZszfj-U7ijqWFc5IrKYksm6nfmxgxsVs3LUw_072GZLQj6g2WmIZbiLCEpgUj0xLOv7ZpXd7sMqeh9gikfUprkH3R_mGu5gbGbW_JFrjNgbYkcV7-ah7gGotK--_9yDoOwyO_F_L6e43s9DJTE8aD3fHUZvA%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=096d364eb9404c0fa05e99a94836a017&_e=nQLuob7rC3vfRkrdMt906MQRXphNP9SJxRh5V5F_1PTo2beP1tK-CPsaf0t6dvjawXakdiBKHpsA7uZDNo5d-I0LYNEOYCvcsnbOGRfUBJjJtOlnNM94bWFIIGcF20jiHFgXM2Ew_l6hULKKmORBiNa6x1zywUc0q2nObIjbut9hhyqCm9NFNXVZr6CiA5eieQCEHp_uSZkoBvtvWTfu-mwy4yOGgWLBvNLDS0TX-x2PkwGpj2Nbfv7u2TJroV_1um0sywm-2QjLCXhZszfj-cMVjNNykD3VT3Y7PmdKDZrq-yNsxOeXNLWmXaQDMeiXU2YWTqYByLKncQ30GbheCHcfeWmSIyO6DBFHiKOtL0CJX0dOtxDz2slofgtV82cFXytXEyww8mOiIKOWc8ETg_q-rN8G6ZfAG2vtUUR6ZIA%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=096d364eb9404c0fa05e99a94836a017&_e=nQLuob7rC3vfRkrdMt906MQRXphNP9SJxRh5V5F_1PTo2beP1tK-CPsaf0t6dvjawXakdiBKHpsA7uZDNo5d-I0LYNEOYCvcsnbOGRfUBJjJtOlnNM94bWFIIGcF20jiHFgXM2Ew_l6hULKKmORBiNa6x1zywUc0q2nObIjbut9hhyqCm9NFNXVZr6CiA5eieQCEHp_uSZkoBvtvWTfu-mwy4yOGgWLBvNLDS0TX-x2PkwGpj2Nbfv7u2TJroV_1um0sywm-2QjLCXhZszfj-T4Zuoy9cBOsG7V_3PMCZ0NtvepievMZRZBpgCzxv1UouQJT2IHAUjnPocKFQePTfuWyG-TpQPIKMV09NRLzOVRuj0ctGxPmJkvMYpsdOGr-18OS2BmQiiS8JkQhXl-HcR0TGlkJnj5_T9rJE088G6s%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678058%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FKQ1tFXoUOvDUYV6%2bCIoBQ&sysid=1)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you’d like to give online, here’s a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678059%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=f7nP7CR8aw4SYSvlenRvUQ&sysid=1)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity’s show that I’ve partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I’m the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left’s cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America’s freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that’s when you know you’re saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America’s founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678050%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UclGZR5yEGG3Y4BhrWALXg&sysid=1)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c678051%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Yq12XoHtnXsw3kz4cmWD3w&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Update

| | On September 22, Jonathan, Sheryl, Justice, and Angelica Emord attended the Patriot Ball in Leesburg, Virginia accompanied by many Team Emord members who traveled to the Ball despite inclement weather. Governor Glenn Youngkin spoke, underscoring the need for early voting in the state elections, reciting “keep the House, flip the Senate.” Early voting is taking place across the Commonwealth now, and all Republicans are urged to go to the polls and vote as soon aspossible, not waiting until the deadline of November 4. The Patriot Ball featured a straw poll for the U.S. Senate race. Candidate Hung Cao who just ran for Congress from the congressional district that includes Leesburg (but lost) had a good night, coming in first with 174 votes. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

The same flag I swore an oath to when I joined the Army.

Peter -
I will never forget January 6th. I was more afraid at the Capitol that day than I was in my entire deployment to Iraq.
On January 6th, I was assaulted by more than 40 rioters and mob members who were part of concerted efforts to overtake the Capitol. I was sprayed with bear mace, punched, kicked, beaten with stolen police batons and weapons. They even attacked us with the American flag.
I still bear the scars of this day and am saddened every time I think about my career being cut short because of this day.
I honestly thought I was going to die.
But I fought back. I fought for our democracy.
I'm still fighting for it.
And while I was fighting the mob, Ruben Gallego was on the House floor. He helped barricade the doors. He taught his colleagues how to use a gas mask. He was ready to fight for our democracy again, same as when he joined the Marines, same as when he fought in Iraq.
He's still fighting for it, too.
He's fighting to beat the people who led those insurrectionists, who cheer them on, who defend them — peoplein Arizona like Mark Lamb, like Kari Lake, like Blake Masters.
Ruben is the kind of leader we need in the Senate, not them. I’m proud to support him. And that's why I'm writing to you today.
To win, he is going to need your help.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5tvtop3pp2n4u7rvojmsehvg6msn908cv2cmtn0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T64ab3293-3da5-4e93-b525-4acf9c25c876/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
