| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T95e516a9-3671-48c3-a29a-eea9fe85477f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter – As Democratic activists, we were extremely concerned to see the news last Friday of Senator Bob Menendez’s second indictment for corruption. Allegedly, Menendez traded favors and peddled influence in exchange for gold bars, cash, and a new Mercedes Benz for his wife. This is not a story that Democrats need to be dealing with while the former Republican President is going to trial on corruption and fraud charges of his own, and we firmly believe Menendez needs to step down from the Senate as swiftly as possible. Prominent Democrats from John Fetterman to NJ Governor Phil Murphy to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Menendez’s own colleague Cory Booker have also called on Menendez to step down, but he has remained defiant, saying: “It is not lost on me how quickly some are rushing to judge [me] and push [me] out of [my] seat.”

Thankfully, we have a path forward even if Menendez refuses to step down: Rep. Andy Kim stepped up over the weekend and announced he would run to primary Menendez in his 2024 U.S. Senate re-election campaign, giving New Jersey voters and concerned Democrats around the country a credible alternative. [Will you pitch in a donation split between Andy Kim’s Senate campaign and Blue Amp Action to help Andy’s team launch with as much momentum as possible before their End Of Quarter deadline?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T19246f40-4a5b-4ae5-bc0d-06de36a6d9da/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---

---

body:
You are an important part of this movement. Let Vivek hear from you before he steps on the debate stage.

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9qkbr1j4er0i74but0ibje7fi2nb8qjkrgehri8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)
Fellow American,

Vivek is ready to head into the second GOP Presidential Debate and continue to lay out his vision for a better America. _**I am so proud of him and this campaign and have never seen a harder-working candidate.**_

One of the best things about Vivek is that he always takes time to have an open dialogue with the people he meets along the campaign trail - even those who may disagree with him. From a protestor at a town hall in Iowa who he was able to calm down and have a heartfelt conversation to a World War II veteran who praised Vivek's vision in New Hampshire saying, "what you're saying is 'exactly what my generation grew up in'" - **meeting people like you is what keeps Vivek going.**

Tens of thousands of people are seeing the level of integrity Vivek represents and will bring to the Office of United States President. **[Now, we thought it would be nice to send Vivek a message of encouragement before his next debate.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5brd8t9uclrf1vjm744d2n593tum0rrgbv1t4l0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)**

| [** SEND VIVEK A PRE-DEBATE MESSAGE → **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zaafd79fp5jn7ivvomn33l0d3agikk5r1091t4o0_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)
---

When Vivek puts his mind to something, **he gets it done.**

When he started this campaign, he had zero political experience and was at 0.0% in polling. Now, he's ranking among the top contenders and ahead of former governors, Vice President, and a sitting United States Senator. Exceeding expectations and delivering the TRUTH will always be his driving force.

Fellow American, Vivek and our team need your help. **[Before Vivek steps on the debate stage, will you send along a message of support and then grow the movement by chipping in $5 or even $35?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zporeu7ga6m9duk59ti4vpt7p6if81brvg1518ag_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)**

Thank you for being a part of Team Vivek and let's carry this success into the next debate!

Thank you,

[
](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsoffm80306mcct77rgu18bjq4seisme4cj218mg_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs) Apoorva Ramaswamy

[** MESSAGE VIVEK BEFORE THE DEBATE → **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsmgl01m8830cigso0cuglp7ba6upom12mrub43g_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmq8ecuvn7m6u38erl6m60mlq0t36lujnv54uts8_rp22sh2s8i66p75c3j62o32chh2bs)

Vivek is a first-generation American. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

I’ll get right to it.
So far, two far-left, radical socialists have jumped into the race trying to court Biden’s endorsement.
Right now they are fighting tooth and nail with each other to see who is the furthest left. While one is an honorary member of AOC’s Squad, the other is the sister of Gretchen Whitmer, the liberal Governor who imposed some of the strictest lockdowns in the nation but refused to follow her own rules.
The rumor is that the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee is going to endorse the one who raises the most money this quarter.
After September 30, our End-of-Quarter Deadline, all our fundraising numbers will be made public. Every journalist will begin to compare their fundraising numbers with ours.

| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

The school season has begun for many Nebraskan families. This coincides with many other "seasons" for most families from fall harvest season to high school sport season, hunting season to holiday season, and onto campaign season. It's a time for traditional activities and events that bring out the best of the Good Life. Tradition is a good thing that brings stability and comfort to our daily/weekly lives because it has a dependable nature to it and we enjoy the social connection to family, church family, and friends.

In the political sphere, the campaign season is upon us. Tradition in campaign season is a good connecting component as candidates walk parades and go door-to-door handing out informational palm cards. Candidates have fundraisers, attend events to make speeches and be present in as many county/state meetings as possible. Over the last two years though, I've found that there are traditional/status quo candidate campaigns, BUT there has become a disconnect between _traditional/status quo_ _governance_ versus **_finding solutions_** _governance_. Over the last two years I have gained context and incite into the difference between traditional institutional politics and an ever increasing awareness to what I call **Value & Solutions Driven** politics. This is the difference between having objectives of just winning elections for the sake of winning OR seeking to make a difference as an elected representative of, by, and for the people. If the Republican Party of Nebraska is to truly move forward for the people and by the people and of the people, we have to address the past. It is absolutely critical for folks to understand the landscape of American politics and not assume the "it can't happen here or Nebraska is too nice for that to happen" mindset. The false assumption that politics is any different here in Nebraska than it is in DC or anywhere else in the United States has blinded Republicans to the truth. We reached a tipping point and it led to July 9th, 2022.

I've referenced this in previous emails that Nebraska is not the RED state that we've been assured it is. There are over 900 elected Democrats in Nebraska and only 17 (Unicameral Senators) are in a position of formal Legislative policy making. In 2017 there were only 504 elected Democrats _(See image from NDP Facebook page)_.

Republicans have **ALL** five Federal seats, **ALL** four Constitutional Officers (Treasure, Auditor, Secretary, Attorney General), Governor, Lt. Governor, **32** very strong leaders in the Unicameral. Only RECENTLY (2022) did we get about half of the Board of Education (3 members). We've had half of the UNL Regents (4 members) for many, many years as they serve 6 year terms. In reality, the only Board or policy making entity Republicans are ALL red in, is the Public Service Commissioners (5 members). The math of voter registration indicates that we have almost a 2-to-1 advantage in registered voters, 600,000+ Republicans versus 350,000 Democrats.

[](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7c7d2586cb&e=25844e23a8)

Which begs the questions...
Where are all the Democrat elected officials?
How could this increase of Democrat numbers happen in only FIVE years?
Why was there **no plan** to _STOP_ the Democrats or even to __**grow the party at the local level**__?

And the bigger questions to ask...**If we are so overwhelmingly a RED state, then**
**Why** are property taxes so high, 6th worst in the nation? And why was there not influence to lower levies to compensate for ever increasing property assessed values over the last 5-10 years?
**Why** did it take until 2023 to lower the inheritance tax and now in 2024 it will probably be eliminated?
**Why** did it take until 2023 to have a Pro-Life Bill that saved and protected the innocent unborn at 12 weeks and beyond?
**Why** did it take until 2020-2021 to bring a huge exposure of the pornography in our public school systems?
**Why** did it take until 2020-2021 to see the proficiency scores for our school systems are under 50%?
**Why** did it take until 2023 to pass constitutional carry and defend our 2nd Amendment rights?
**Why** did it take a Petition, then Ballot Initiative, and millions of dollars to FORCE a Photo Voter ID law that 65.47% of Nebraskans clearly wanted? (more on Election Accountability and Voter Verification in future emails)

Here is the TRUTH...from what I have surmised is for the last decade, the leaders of the NEGOP controlled the major political races **(roughly 40 seats)** through _direct financial candidate support_ (i.e. big dollar checks written), having a national political consultant company **operate the day-to-day functions** (_including payroll, compliance, vendor creative content, and all communication structure_) and a **closed network** of information and communication to the elected members of the _State Central Committee and Convention Delegates._ We have to think bigger than JUST to win ELECTIONS in 2024. **_In 2024 the NEGOP has a plan!_**
☑ We have passed a 2-year Political Plan focusing on County Party Development & EDUCATION which will be reviewed again in April of 2024.
☑We have passed our 2nd Unicameral Session Legislative Plan to work with Senator for SOLUTIONS to Education, Election Integrity, Taxes, Protecting Children & Winner-Take-All Electoral vote in 2024.
☑We have passed a 2-year budget which will be reviewed again in January of 2024. As a point of context, the approved 2024 NEGOP budget has **NO** line item for _DIRECT FINANCIAL CANDIDATE SUPPORT_. Meaning, when you **[DONATE](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=bd31319022&e=25844e23a8)** to the NEGOP it goes to OPERATE the party, PAY salaries & utilities, SUPPORT county party development, AND provide the __**RESOURCES**__ to the candidates. It is not the OBJECTIVE or the job of the State party to pick and choose the winners of elections...that is the VOTERS job to pick their representatives. __**Nearly ALL other state parties operate in a similar financial fashion where they DO NOT write direct financial checks to candidates.**__

WHEN YOU DONATE TO THE PARTY, _100%_ OF YOUR DONATION GOES TO **BUILD THE PARTY**! It does NOT go to Federal or State or Legislative candidates. This change of budget philosophy was SCC approved, yet is so despised by some that they actively work against the party, they actively work against YOU, and encourage large donors NOT to donate.

To be beyond reproach and transparent, I will focus my next newsletter on the clarity of the relationships with elected officials and WHO really ran the party before July 9th.

Please stay tuned for upcoming "Morning Coffee w/ the Chairman" newsletters as I will bring to light the TRUTH of the last year within the Republican Party of Nebraska.

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,

## Coalition Spotlight: Protect Nebraska Children
---
|
# Protect Nebraska Children
### Who we are & why we matter:
####
The History of Protect Nebraska Children Coalition
In March of 2021, the State Board of Education released Health Standards that _shocked_ the State. “Standards” are what school districts use to guide their curriculum choices, so they are important. The new Health Standards featured Sex Education that was more about race and gender ideology than anatomy, and introduced these concepts as young as Kindergarten. Fourth graders would learn about vaginal intercourse, fifth graders about puberty blockers, and seventh graders about anal sex. A few startled parents initiated a Facebook group called Protect Nebraska Children. Within 2 months the group had 11,000 members, and by May there were 400 people showing up to the previously tame State Board of Education meetings. It was clear to the public that the State Board of Education had lost it’s way. Protect Nebraska Children Coalition was formed from a group of these citizens who researched further. We learned that Planned Parenthood has a preferred curriculum to get students into their lucrative abortion and transgender hormone pipeline. It is called **[Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE)](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=5b4ecf756d&e=25844e23a8)** and details can be found at **[protectnebraskachildren.org](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=25b866dd06&e=25844e23a8).** PNC obtained public records disclosure of board member Deborah Neary’s emails. They revealed collusion between Ms. Neary, the Nebraska Department of Education Commissioner and his staff, the Women’s Fund of Omaha, and SIECUS:Sex Ed for social change. **[(siecus.org)](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9bfd323bc2&e=25844e23a8)** to insert the Planned Parenthood sex standards into the otherwise teacher-led development process. It was the disclosure of those emails that finally led to the “tabled indefinitely” status of the Health Standards in August 2021. The Nebraska Dept. of Education website at that time was replete with resources for teachers that promoted critical race theory, the 1619 project, and links to Marxist content and organizations. (After that content was publicly revealed, some was removed. Much of it is still there although harder to find.) Further research into the Nebraska Dept. of Education revealed that in September of 2019, the Commissioner presented, and the State Board voted for, their plan to delete all references to “equality” from their official position statement, and replace it with the word “equity.” Those familiar with critical race theory will recognize this as a nod toward Neo-Marxist doctrine. The Commissioner followed that move with a public statement** [proclaiming that “social justice” and “anti-racism”](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b1b051ad4f&e=25844e23a8)** will henceforth be the primary goal of Nebraska Education. The 2021 Sex Ed standards, and the rapidly collapsing levels of literacy in our 2023 schools, are a direct result of those priorities set in 2019.
#### PNC Shines in 2022
Some major house cleaning at the Nebraska Dept. of Education and the State Board of Education was clearly in order. The Protect Nebraska Children Coalition assisted in the formation of Protect Nebraska Children PAC. The goal was to replace 4 state board members in 2022. Many Nebraskans donated a few dollars a month, and every penny was used on the campaigns of our 4 candidates. Three of them were elected. Sherry Jones, Kirk Penner, and Elizabeth Tegtmeier. Unfortunately, Deborah Neary retained her seat with the help of large donations from the NSEA, and Planned Parenthood and their affiliates. Five of the eight current State Board of Education members are still believers in anti-racism over reading, and transgender over science. The old Commissioner of Education, seeing the writing on the wall, resigned to become a lobbyist for his “social justice” causes. The new Commissioner was hired on a vote of 5-3.
#### **Fighting to Protect the Minds of School Children**
The State Board of Education is a non-partisan race. There are no R’s or D’s on the ballot, but it is imperative that every citizen understands who they are voting for in 2024. The days of retired teachers running unopposed are over. The battle for the minds of our young people is a serious one. Activist teachers are **[implementing race and gender theory lessons](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9e51221f28&e=25844e23a8)** right under the noses of parents in every single school district across the state. Don’t think it isn’t in _your_ school. It is. Even at Omaha Westside, considered one of the premier school districts in the state, administrators admitted their daily efforts to confuse and lie to parents. Remarkably, the only consequences for the people on this video were positive ones. They were celebrated by the Ed community for their efforts. See video **[HERE](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fb24208a7e&e=25844e23a8).**
#### Every District Matters in a Statewide Race

clean_body: Coalition Spotlight Feature: Protect Nebraska Children | | | | | | | Good Morning Republicans, The school season has begun for many Nebraskan families. This coincides with many other "seasons" for most families from fall harvest season to high school sport season, hunting season to holiday season, and onto campaign season. It's a time for traditional activities and events that bring out the best of the Good Life. Tradition is a good thing that brings stability and comfort to our daily/weekly lives because it has a dependable nature to it and we enjoy the social connection to family, church family, and friends. In the political sphere, the campaign season is upon us. Tradition in campaign season is a good connecting component as candidates walk parades and go door-to-door handing out informational palm cards. Candidates have fundraisers, attend events to make speeches and be present in as many county/state meetings as possible. Over the last two years though, I've found that there are traditional/status quo candidate campaigns, BUT there has become a disconnect between traditional/status quo governance versus finding solutions governance. Over the last two years I have gained context and incite into the difference between traditional institutional politics and an ever increasing awareness to what I call Value & Solutions Driven politics. This is the difference between having objectives of just winning elections for the sake of winning OR seeking to make a difference as an elected representative of, by, and for the people. If the Republican Party of Nebraska is to truly move forward for the people and by the people and of the people, we have to address the past. It is absolutely critical for folks to understand the landscape of American politics and not assume the "it can't happen here or Nebraska is too nice for that to happen" mindset. The false assumption that politics is any different here in Nebraska than it is in DC or anywhere else in the United States has blinded Republicans to the truth. We reached a tipping point and it led to July 9th, 2022. I've referenced this in previous emails that Nebraska is not the RED state that we've been assured it is. There are over 900 elected Democrats in Nebraska and only 17 (Unicameral Senators) are in a position of formal Legislative policy making. In 2017 there were only 504 elected Democrats (See image from NDP Facebook page). Republicans have ALL five Federal seats, ALL four Constitutional Officers (Treasure, Auditor, Secretary, Attorney General), Governor, Lt. Governor, 32 very strong leaders in the Unicameral. Only RECENTLY (2022) did we get about half of the Board of Education (3 members). We've had half of the UNL Regents (4 members) for many, many years as they serve 6 year terms. In reality, the only Board or policy making entity Republicans are ALL red in, is the Public Service Commissioners (5 members). The math of voter registration indicates that we have almost a 2-to-1 advantage in registered voters, 600,000+ Republicans versus 350,000 Democrats. Which begs the questions... Where are all the Democrat elected officials? How could this increase of Democrat numbers happen in only FIVE years? Why was there no plan to STOP the Democrats or even to grow the party at the local level? And the bigger questions to ask...If we are so overwhelmingly a RED state, then Why are property taxes so high, 6th worst in the nation? And why was there not influence to lower levies to compensate for ever increasing property assessed values over the last 5-10 years? Why did it take until 2023 to lower the inheritance tax and now in 2024 it will probably be eliminated? Why did it take until 2023 to have a Pro-Life Bill that saved and protected the innocent unborn at 12 weeks and beyond? Why did it take until 2020-2021 to bring a huge exposure of the pornography in our public school systems? Why did it take until 2020-2021 to see the proficiency scores for our school systems are under 50%? Why did it take until 2023 to pass constitutional carry and defend our 2nd Amendment rights? Why did it take a Petition, then Ballot Initiative, and millions of dollars to FORCE a Photo Voter ID law that 65.47% of Nebraskans clearly wanted? (more on Election Accountability and Voter Verification in future emails) Here is the TRUTH...from what I have surmised is for the last decade, the leaders of the NEGOP controlled the major political races (roughly 40 seats) through direct financial candidate support (i.e. big dollar checks written), having a national political consultant company operate the day-to-day functions (including payroll, compliance, vendor creative content, and all communication structure) and a closed network of information and communication to the elected members of the State Central Committee and Convention Delegates. We have to think bigger than JUST to win ELECTIONS in 2024. In 2024 the NEGOP has a plan! ☑ We have passed a 2-year Political Plan focusing on County Party Development & EDUCATION which will be reviewed again in April of 2024. ☑We have passed our 2nd Unicameral Session Legislative Plan to work with Senator for SOLUTIONS to Education, Election Integrity, Taxes, Protecting Children & Winner-Take-All Electoral vote in 2024. ☑We have passed a 2-year budget which will be reviewed again in January of 2024. As a point of context, the approved 2024 NEGOP budget has NO line item for DIRECT FINANCIAL CANDIDATE SUPPORT. Meaning, when you to the NEGOP it goes to OPERATE the party, PAY salaries & utilities, SUPPORT county party development, AND provide the RESOURCES to the candidates. It is not the OBJECTIVE or the job of the State party to pick and choose the winners of elections...that is the VOTERS job to pick their representatives. Nearly ALL other state parties operate in a similar financial fashion where they DO NOT write direct financial checks to candidates. WHEN YOU DONATE TO THE PARTY, 100% OF YOUR DONATION GOES TO BUILD THE PARTY! It does NOT go to Federal or State or Legislative candidates. This change of budget philosophy was SCC approved, yet is so despised by some that they actively work against the party, they actively work against YOU, and encourage large donors NOT to donate. To be beyond reproach and transparent, I will focus my next newsletter on the clarity of the relationships with elected officials and WHO really ran the party before July 9th. Please stay tuned for upcoming "Morning Coffee w/ the Chairman" newsletters as I will bring to light the TRUTH of the last year within the Republican Party of Nebraska. The truth shall set us free. | Peter, **Hudson Bob is at it again.** **Democratic Senator Bob Menendez, his wife Nadine, and three New Jersey businessmen were just charged with participating in a bribery scheme.** The couple allegedly accepted hundreds of thousands of dollars of bribes in exchange for Menendez’s agreement to use his official position to protect and enrich the businessmen and to benefit the Government of Egypt.
When authorities searched the senator's residence, they found gold bars and envelopes of cash hidden in clothing, closets and a safe. For someone with a longstanding history of corruption and legal issues, Bob sure does have a lot of nerve to continue his shady business.
It's almost as though he knows he will probably get away with it. **_The corruption in New Jersey is out of control, and we are sick of it._** If you've had enough, **_it's time to take action._** It's time to join a group of people that have come together to fight the corruption and get public officials to start acting in the best interests of citizens. If this is resonating with you, [**click here to learn more about how you can get involved and become a member of the Common Sense Club today.**](https://xtz223.keap-link009.com/v2/click/9e295158d7c7714d440f55f1e80a2893/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnE1z7QO8iUSI1iHqHItOuaXrsk2Zif-9tcJTQdd3nnmGd1oglFxSlIEPd3ow5oEFGlOhBEoKK0k8fU3ZdOJ6rgWFkOelrq4K_Pbr8gD0sTv1ZhZQo9Ag200QxtF6uU-idWxIxbW58Z-HzdngWayCKIGu-ynGUtDiZtwX8ElfsW-UCdOKdrowfE6kLr7j1HVtnyohKceDOObExsyz06p0-nCEJReFsXGlUGafV8TYvJ3dEyIaZvI=)

Many arrogant, elitist elected officials crushed our way of life during the misguided, unnecessary and deadly lockdowns. Now it’s time to hold them accountable for their actions, ignorance and negligence. The tide is turning, and today is only STEP ONE!

This year’s elections provide a can’t-miss opportunity to support small businesses and families with fiscally responsible policies, restore an education system that puts students and parents over the radical agenda of the NJEA elites, and protect and preserve our civil, economic, and medical liberty.
We believe that our government should serve the people and provide the expected services that we’re paying for! It’s time for government to function as a public service, not a propaganda tool for radicals.
We believe in REDUCING tax burdens on working families AND empowering the skilled trades and small businesses.
We believe our schools should reject Critical Race Theory and the sexualized curricula. It’s time to empower parents and stop the NJEA once and for all.
I hope you’ll join me TODAY as we discuss the results of this year’s critical elections.
If you want to stand with me against the out-of-touch career politicians who are taking New Jersey down the wrong path and help restore Common Sense, you’re in the right place!Please join me during my show tonight, call in to share your thoughts, and watch the results of this year’s elections live as they come in!
Together, we can keep working to restore Common Sense and save New Jersey and America.
Thank you,Bill Spadea

Fear and hate, when merged, create a potent political opium that is intoxicating to the ruling elites of our time and propels them to unprecedented heights of power. Remarkably cost-effective, this potent brew has been wielded to tremendous effect in recent times, specifically by generating fear and hate around the myth of ongoing race-based persecution. And though the alleged beneficiary of this opiate is the black community, we are in actual fact harmed by it--while the ruling class benefits.
A frightening trend has emerged in which the word "racist" is wielded carelessly and ruthlessly--predominantly by those who use it to increase polarization. Once the allegation of racism was used to combat true bigotry and cultivate our nation's genuine empathy--the source of our power. Today, the Left uses the term against any idea they can't debate on the merits, or don't understand, or even just to mask their own failures. And of course, it's used to smear the Left's political opponents--especially those willing to tell the truth about race in America.
Republican presidential candidate [Vivek Ramaswamy](https://substack.com/redirect/30ce285b-60d5-4109-b573-5d40ba7b3303?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), whose campaign I am advising, is a case in point. There have been multiple attempts to brand Ramaswamy as racist for speaking out on the severe challenges the black community is grappling with. But these smears are shallow and only hurt black individuals and communities.
It's no secret that our community faces a myriad of issues. We're often hesitant to bring our problems to the forefront, not wanting to air our dirty laundry in public, hoping that by ignoring them, they'll go unnoticed. But our problems are glaring.
We consistently vote in large numbers for a political party that hasn't reciprocated our loyalty with tangible benefits. Our neighborhoods are notorious for their high crime rates. Our children are suffering in inadequate schools. We have an unacceptably high rate of abortions. Our children--our future--step off school buses daily with their pants sagging to their knees. Too many fathers are nowhere to be found.
Our problems are visible for all to see. We must ask ourselves why too many of our precious babies are being raised in neighborhoods controlled by gangs, littered with drug paraphernalia and saturated with the putrid scent of sweat and urine?
The blame can be attributed to various factors, including administrators, politicians, unions, and powerbrokers.
The one person who can't be blamed for any of our problems is Vivek Ramaswamy. He is simply a person unafraid to point them out.
When someone like Vivek points out these issues, it's essential not to react with anger. Instead, let's channel that anger into demanding better, into fixing what's broken.
Get angry--but not at those who shed light on our problems. Get mad at those who had the power to change the course of predominantly black communities and chose not to act. It's time to stop tolerating the intolerable.
It's time to stop allowing ourselves to be manipulated so the ruling class can accrue power that benefits everyone but us. For our sake and for the generations yet to come, stop shooting the messenger when the message is righteous and necessary.
_The power lies within us to demand change, and we must exercise it._

Peter,

As Republicans have moved to restrict the right to vote across the nation, _**we’re fighting back.**_

But this doesn’t mean we can lay our guard down. Aggressive attempts to restrict the right to vote are happening in battleground states, including North Carolina. The right to vote is fundamental in a democracy, and our ability to defend it will rely on our work to protect access to the ballot.

# [This Republican bill would end ALL state and local animal welfare and food safety laws. Tell congress to reject it!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3962f34e-2424-4790-8364-2de97b09971f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---

---
| | | It's hard to express just how extreme and dangerous this bill is. In one fell swoop, the "Ending Agricultural Trade Suppression [Act](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2dc3758f-34bf-4790-a3c3-f1f7f075f3fa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)" would END the authority of states and localities to regulate animal welfare and food safety standards. A whole host of laws would be nullified, and farmed animals would have no protection against being forced into cramped and horrific conditions. This would dramatically increase the likelihood of communicable diseases running rampant among these animals — with humans getting sick as well. It's a recipe for disaster, and it's a terrible idea. And there's no way congress should pass it. [**Add your name now, and tell Congress to reject the Ending Agricultural Trade Suppression Act.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T70702b76-5b36-4d7e-ae98-c1abdfbcbe5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: Trump just attacked us for making voting more accessible in Pennsylvania

body:
Peter,
Last week, we announced that Pennsylvania is officially an automatic voter registration state. It's a commonsense change that will help tens of thousands of Pennsylvanians make their voice heard – no matter who you choose to vote for or what your views are.
Donald Trump, apparently, has a problem with that. He's already attacking me and automatic voter registration, accusing me and other Democrats of a conspiracy to steal the 2024 election in Pennsylvania.
But he can't change the facts: automatic voter registration actually makes our voter rolls more secure, saves taxpayers money, and helps make sure every legal, eligible voter can make their voice heard. That's why bipartisan states like West Virginia, Florida, and Georgia have implemented it, too.
Peter, you and I both know this is more of the same baseless nonsense that Trump's been peddling ever since he lost Pennsylvania in 2020. But you can bet he's going to whip his fellow election deniers into a frenzy over our efforts to expand voting access, and we need to be prepared to protect our progress.
**[That starts with re-electing strong leaders like Bob Casey. Bob is a strong defender of democracy in the Senate, so can you please rush a $5 donation to his re-election campaign today? We need to make sure he has what it takes to succeed no matter how many more baseless attacks Donald Trump throws at our Commonwealth.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230927-1?refcode=em20230927-1&refcode2=764_552475_rAUHNX&akid=764%2E552475%2ErAUHNX)**
Automatic voter registration is a critical part of our effort to safeguard our democracy, secure our elections, and ensure every legal and eligible Pennsylvanian's right to vote. This is the work I promised to take on when I was elected, and we wouldn't be able to take this monumental step forward without the support of a dedicated grassroots team.
But Trump's latest attack shows how much work it's going to take to defend our progress -- and to continue to fight back against his ongoing efforts to undermine our elections here in Pennsylvania.
**[I'm in this fight for the long haul, Peter, and I know Bob is too. If you're with us, I'd be so grateful if you could make a donation and help Bob protect Pennsylvania's democracy for years to come.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230927-1?refcode=em20230927-1&refcode2=764_552475_rAUHNX&akid=764%2E552475%2ErAUHNX)**

Thanks for everything,
Josh

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: Rep. Maxwell Frost

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
It's Maxwell Frost here.
This is a massive win for our youth-led movement to end gun violence across the country.
Alongside young activists, organizers, and leaders like Alexandria, I’m proud to have fought for the creation of a federal office of gun violence prevention.
Ending gun violence is what called me to action – both as the National Organizing Director for March for our Lives and as the first of my generation to be elected to Congress.
My generation has been demanding action. And today, we have real, tangible progress in this fight. Not incremental progress, but a massive push forward. This is a major step forward to addressing our gun violence epidemic with action and policy.
But we know the NRA and gun lobby are plotting revenge against our movement. Alexandria and I need to be prepared, so we’re setting out to raise $25,000 to keep us in the fight to end gun violence.
[Can you split a $5 donation to my campaign and Alexandria to power our movement for progress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230927-frost.oXOsIE&refcode=em20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230927-frost.oXOsIE&refcode=em20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)**
**Republicans said a young organizer wouldn’t stand a chance against the gun lobby and the NRA-bought Republicans in Congress.**
And when I introduced my first bill in Congress to establish a federal office of gun violence prevention, Republicans thought they succeeded in blocking it.
But I never gave up, and neither did Alexandria. Now, the Biden Administration is taking action. Our collective power made this happen. This is proof that our youth-powered movement is unstoppable. And we’re just getting started.
**So today, we celebrate this win in the fight to end gun violence. Tomorrow, we _keep_ fighting. We _keep_ organizing. We _keep_ making noise.** But it’s going to be an uphill battle against major forces that will stop at nothing to crush our progress. That’s why Alexandria and I are counting on you to keep our movement strong – both on the ground and in Congress.
[ I’m asking every single person reading this to step up with a split donation today to help Alexandria and I hit our $25,000 fundraising goal so we can keep up the fight to end gun violence. Can you rush a $5 split donation right now?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230927-frost.oXOsIE&refcode=em20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230927-frost.oXOsIE&refcode=em20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=40&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)**
Let’s keep this going,
Rep. Maxwell Frost

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230927-frost?refcode=em20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=41&refcode2=5048_2526796_M8glj8&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20230927-5048-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=42&akid=5048%2E2526796%2EM8glj8)**

Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6d67a94757324cf28ceda8e112e6a633&_e=cegD159RCZ6gUSuOxaiq0bz75wbr9voWjwUXzW0jMXPQM02QH9mVhDlQglTouy61SLSQONIa8SpXF35kv3ghuLOHO0pp8lERaA42W_MROKH5Q50O8mDon8fDxFdjbmcNOtslClS6JFqSd-7DKcs4bcIQ7uiBjFo1GFa6MAUW26uN59D3Xq3uT0K9av91y0IaUMtBDLSP9TiqDtH7J5jT37AW4lUWGOxpzdOrOme0fmsheHdgjqEOFJWgA0HqXUAqdXf8XH1Hq-uVawtQp9F20-OtV7z8aAEzFVIgyw4WQUOiWqqGFw9ptX-UssJSgJqris16VfSoYwT-u_Yia7QKHFudaa3IkJ43okERQ8BOmJo%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6d67a94757324cf28ceda8e112e6a633&_e=cegD159RCZ6gUSuOxaiq0bz75wbr9voWjwUXzW0jMXPQM02QH9mVhDlQglTouy61SLSQONIa8SpXF35kv3ghuLOHO0pp8lERaA42W_MROKH5Q50O8mDon8fDxFdjbmcNOtslClS6JFqSd-7DKcs4bcIQ7uiBjFo1GFa6MAUW26uN59D3Xq3uT0K9av91y0IaUMtBDLSP9TiqDtH7J5jT3-fSg3cKisPQB6JWou0Og9Zfz71N8wU2pSrpzJ9t-AlzzL4zYtj7cbOcRccaDZY9LFwLG4Uv7ygqmgTsUTx7y4WTruMn028yCu_j0IxVG7PSaIg-vekL3feW82DPzY6xWFg37HRKypgfOyxH32uAIjg%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines

subject: This is a story about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
And how Republicans like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[chip in toward our end-of-quarter goal of raising 35,000 individual donations.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37490?refcode=em20230927-3861&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3861%2E614464%2E9H8MhU) But first, I want to take some time this morning to share a bit about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me.**
Please let me explain:
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37490?refcode=em20230927-3861&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3861%2E614464%2E9H8MhU)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37490?refcode=em20230927-3861&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3861%2E614464%2E9H8MhU)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and pouring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger?
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/37490?refcode=em20230927-3861&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3861%2E614464%2E9H8MhU)
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.

clean_body: And how Republicans like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to But first, I want to take some time this morning to share a bit about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me. Please let me explain: It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us. Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty. For me, that was planning our routes and pouring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely. Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country. When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there. Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer. So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger? I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits. Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war. These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it. I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate. We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have. subject: Two numbers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
What they are up to is nuts.
#
Derek, we have to share what's got us rolling our eyes right now -- **[but if you're ready to help us maximize the fundraising number we file with the FEC with our deadline in just three days, you can chip in right here.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230927-1?refcode=em20230927-1-8590&refcode2=8590_434096_LuKKaq&akid=8590%2E434096%2ELuKKaq)**
**Ten.** That's how many days the media -- *especially* Fox News -- have spent melting down about a change in Senate dress code, blaming John for “the deterioration of this country” + literally comparing the rules change to the fall of Rome. (We WISH we were kidding.)
Meanwhile -- **three.** That's how many days we are away from a full government shutdown.
If a shutdown happens, it will be _catastrophic_ for the middle class -- causing delays to travel + supply chains, stalling paychecks for millions of government employees + service members, and hurting those who rely on government assistance to get by.
I mean c'mon. How wrong can the fringe right's priorities be???
**We need to take the threat of a MAGA shutdown seriously, and we need to have serious representatives working hard to keep the government running -- no matter what they choose to wear to do it.**
**[If you're with us, chip in any amount to help us reach our end-of-quarter fundraising goal and power John's work in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230927-1?refcode=em20230927-1-8590&refcode2=8590_434096_LuKKaq&akid=8590%2E434096%2ELuKKaq)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230927-1?refcode=em20230927-8590&refcode2=8590_434096_LuKKaq&akid=8590%2E434096%2ELuKKaq)**
If you ask us, the GOP wilfully derailing the government shows way more disrespect to our institutions than showing up to work in a hoodie. 🤷
But that's why we're on John's team. Thanks for your support. 🙏
-- Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20230927-8590-footer&t=1&refcode2=8590_434096_LuKKaq&akid=8590%2E434096%2ELuKKaq)**

subject: Before Trump takes the stage tonight

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=714%2E135344%2Ei3S9nQ)

I am asking you to make a contribution of $3 directly to my campaign for Senate before Donald Trump takes the stage at his event in Michigan tonight.
Here's the link:
[**https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/Trump-Visit](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep23.hbnlDo&refcode=em230927-1-15f&t=2&akid=714%2E135344%2Ei3S9nQ)**
Tonight, Donald Trump is skipping the second GOP debate and making a big, splashy visit to Michigan to energize Republicans who think they can flip this battleground state. To show his support for the UAW, he’ll be taking the stage at a non-unionized facility in Macomb County.
What we’ve seen this week is really a tale of two visits: Trump says he’s coming to “support striking workers”, but he is coming to a non-union plant. And when UAW workers at GM were on strike in 2019, then-President Trump stood on the sidelines and said nothing in support. Meanwhile, yesterday, President Biden became the first President to join a picket line and stand with workers in solidarity. The difference couldn’t be more stark.
**But the truth is that Trump’s visit isn’t really about supporting workers, it’s about scoring political points in a state that will be central to his presidential campaign.**
Donald Trump calls Michigan a "must-win" state for him and that "if we win Michigan, we win the presidency." Trump's campaign said "this will be a knockdown, drag-out fight to the very end." You may recall, Trump won Michigan in 2016 by 10,704 votes, and lost it in 2020 by 154,118 votes.
So what does that mean for our race for Senate? It means we're going to be seeing Trump in Michigan a whole lot. And National Republicans will be doing everything they can to flip our state red and boost our GOP opponent in the Senate race.
There's also going to be an extraordinary amount of outside spending in this race. We're going to see relentless attack ads against me because I tend to do well in the areas of Michigan often overlooked by Democrats. With the Senate race being the top of the ticket here in Michigan, their strategy will be to drag me down in the hopes of not only winning this Senate race, but flipping the White House red too.
**This is why I have to ask:**
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to our campaign for Senate in Michigan before our FEC fundraising deadline ends on Saturday night? Even a small donation would be a help!](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep23.hbnlDo&refcode=em230927-1-15f&t=3&akid=714%2E135344%2Ei3S9nQ)**

| | Peter — I'm sure your inbox is getting hit with dozens of emails about the FEC's end-of-quarter fundraising deadline today [(and of course, we welcome your support)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70454112/429417031/1183499175?refcode=2023-09-27-bio&recurring=&amount=15&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=13d9d826-535d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTNkOWQ4MjYtNTM1ZC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7nzrd3QpuJ1XoxpfrIVibk-VRpUbBd2QHbO9EJ9Y-fI=), **but I wanted to take a moment to talk about why I'm even running for Congress in the first place.** My path to this race didn't begin with an eye towards D.C., but in a classroom in south Los Angeles. I began my career as a public school English teacher, at Markham Middle School in Watts. Every day, I had the privilege of working with bright, creative students — but too often I saw kids struggle with circumstances they couldn't control. All I ever sought to do was help my students find their passions in life and achieve their goals. I took on many different roles at Markham so I could be there for my students — teacher, coach, club sponsor. **Yet budget cuts and outdated policy resulted in myself and two-thirds of all teachers at Markham getting laid off.** Quality educators lost their jobs, just for lacking seniority. Even worse, Markham was expected to serve the needs of all students with a severely reduced staff, putting even more strain on teachers working with bare minimum resources. I knew I had to do something. This was so much more than saving my own job — **this was about making sure every student was set up to succeed and thrive.** So, I took the fight to the school board. Not only did I push for Markham to rehire quality teachers, but I also joined the ACLU in a groundbreaking civil rights case against LAUSD, defending students' right to a quality education for every kid in the district. Since then, I've gone on to do impactful work as a civil rights advocate, and as a school board member, standing up for parents, teachers, and kids every day. I know that our community is strong when every person, big or small, has the tools to succeed. **That's the attitude I had as a teacher, and that is the attitude I will bring to Congress.** [**Before our next FEC deadline, can you pitch in $15 to our campaign? clean_body: Taking a moment to reflect on this campaign. | | | | Peter — I'm sure your inbox is getting hit with dozens of emails about the FEC's end-of-quarter fundraising deadline today =, but I wanted to take a moment to talk about why I'm even running for Congress in the first place. My path to this race didn't begin with an eye towards D.C., but in a classroom in south Los Angeles. I began my career as a public school English teacher, at Markham Middle School in Watts. Every day, I had the privilege of working with bright, creative students — but too often I saw kids struggle with circumstances they couldn't control. All I ever sought to do was help my students find their passions in life and achieve their goals. I took on many different roles at Markham so I could be there for my students — teacher, coach, club sponsor. Yet budget cuts and outdated policy resulted in myself and two-thirds of all teachers at Markham getting laid off. Quality educators lost their jobs, just for lacking seniority. Even worse, Markham was expected to serve the needs of all students with a severely reduced staff, putting even more strain on teachers working with bare minimum resources. I knew I had to do something. This was so much more than saving my own job — this was about making sure every student was set up to succeed and thrive. So, I took the fight to the school board. Not only did I push for Markham to rehire quality teachers, but I also joined the ACLU in a groundbreaking civil rights case against LAUSD, defending students' right to a quality education for every kid in the district. Since then, I've gone on to do impactful work as a civil rights advocate, and as a school board member, standing up for parents, teachers, and kids every day. I know that our community is strong when every person, big or small, has the tools to succeed. That's the attitude I had as a teacher, and that is the attitude I will bring to Congress. = = Thank you for standing with us, Nick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Nick Melvoin for Congress - FEC ID #C00831289 |

body:

Friend,

I
am the only candidate in this race who will be able to get the
job done for our country, our freedom, our future, and your
children-and that's why I've felt a responsibility to step up and
run to serve as your next President.

I
can't wait to take the stage tonight at the second Republican
debate. I am ready to show that, under my leadership, success is
attainable.

Chip in before I take the stage!

America is suffering under Joe Biden's leadership. I've heard
countless stories from families across the country that I've met
on the campaign trail who tell me that they're struggling to
afford groceries, anxious about how they're going to pay their
next bill, and wondering how they're going to support their
children.

Friend, that's not the American Dream I grew up on and it makes
me sick that this is the reality so many American families have
to live with.

That's why, when I take the debate stage tonight, I'm going to
fight tooth and nail. I refuse to put up with childish antics or
anything that derails us from our mission: our Great American
Comeback. I promise you, what you're going to hear from me is a
plan that secures our border, restores American energy dominance,
ensures we're paying $2.00 at the pump in 2025, and restores our
economy.

Friend, I'm going to be blunt with you. This week is one of the
most important weeks of this entire campaign and if we don't come
out on top, we'll be ripped apart. Since day one, I've promised
you that I will never back down, and I don't intend to start now.

Before I take the stage, I want to ask you for one favor: will
you donate $25? When I take the stage, I want to go up there
knowing that our team came together to show the world that Team
DeSantis is ready to win this race.

Help me meet our goal: Donate $25

My
goal is to have 1,500 team members come together to chip in $25
or more before I take the debate stage. I'm betting that that
show of force will send a clear message to the entire nation that
we'll never back down.

In
Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

Do you realize that God is behind you?” [And Peter, before I show you Trump’s answer, can you help us respond with a $10 contribution split between Blue Amp Action and my campaign? It will come as no surprise that he attacked me once again — he knows how effective I have been in holding him to account and doesn’t want me elected to the Senate — and he is doing all he can to stop me.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T314f30d9-438e-4a3f-8945-c5ae36b4e828/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Here’s what Trump said: [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04c96c79-88d4-4e69-9971-f3b0296d227a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) “Now think of how bad these people were. A guy like Adam shifty Schiff, who is a real bad guy. I call him Pencil Neck because he has the smallest neck I’ve ever seen. He’s not gonna be playing for your local teams — Iowa, Iowa State, they’re not gonna be recruiting him to play football.” Whether Trump is making petty personal insults or calling for my imprisonment, we can never let his demagogic attacks go unanswered. Trump is attacking me because he knows I am effective, and because he fears what I can do as a Senator to stand up to the MAGA bullies. Scared, because when I stood up to him, I secured the first bipartisan vote in history to impeach a sitting president. Scared, because he knows I hold those who abuse their power accountable — whether it’s him, big corporations, or any other special interests that are rigging the rules and making life harder for working families. This pencil neck won’t break. He’s scared of the grassroots coalition we’re building. A coalition that’s fighting for affordable housing. To save the planet. To build an economy that works for everyone. A coalition that’s going to come together and win. name: Jackson Lahmeyer
subject: Exciting Announcement | Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan.Church Tulsa
body:
Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan We have a VERY special guest speaker coming to Sheridan.Church that I know will make a huge impact upon you
| | |
---
## Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.724.1.4718ed3b0a362cb1095b98d8fb658728)
---
We have a VERY special guest speaker coming to [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.725.1.7442d848c6f9cabf649314489e5ffcfd) that I know will make a huge impact upon you and your family.
I have always been a _major_ sports fan.
One evening, I watched an ESPN 30 for 30 documentary on the great **New York Mets** baseball player **Darryl Strawberry**.
I knew of **Darryl Strawberry's** tremendous career and his unfortunate downfall to drugs later in his career.
What I did not know was how God restored him and called Darryl to the ministry.
Shortly after learning this, I began following **Darryl Strawberry** and his ministry and have been amazed at the preacher he is.
This is why I am excited to invite you to join me at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.726.1.745d7deb27189f30e4cca18484224685) Tulsa on **Sunday, October 8** to hear **Darryl Strawberry** preach the Gospel!
Service Time: 10am CT
Location: 7901 E 41st St Tulsa, OK
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.727.1.321ba2935e4bbc39bebb3d6eb672bb70), GAB, [Facebook](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.728.1.09b2baa2a89ebdb66ca5ca3abb980fb7), [Instagram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.729.1.5d6224280ca01f4149b3c4b8b88cb9a9), [Twitter](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.730.1.1ba8ac97faa28bf965b8267cce8e2ada), [Telegram](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.731.1.6f958f7de5ebbca9e2777775d68f6b7a), GETTR & [YouTube](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.732.1.bba83cc593ac8edffad6db41ee839b68)).
[www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.733.1.f998861ab36988ce609f443e1ecaca8f)
| | [ Partner w/Sheridan.Church Tulsa & OKC ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.734.1.05625a316327d7aba013260cfdcb4aea)
---
---
## How God Does Math...
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.735.1.19ea7237b32abe9b1a40f2f23c79eb1d)
---
I have learned through studying _Scripture_ and being in the _ministry_ that **God does math differently** than how I was taught to do math...
This Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.736.1.99d92d15de2bff08fea8e6db677d550c), I showed our church family a secret in the Kingdom of the God that is all throughout Scripture: **God's Math Equation**.
God's math goes something like this - _Addition By Subraction To Produce Multiplication_
If that makes no sense to you right now, don't worry. Watch this sermon and I promise it will bless you!
[Acts Pt. 21 - Addition By Subtraction](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.737.1.073a96a9c84c83e3e7fb3148ea8a2816)
| | [ Watch: Acts Pt. 21 - Addition By Subtraction ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1978194.738.1.070d51f7b2ca64486a25e38deb832454)

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Where there is a crisis, there is also an opportunity

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0e2b98b9c1794b4ab828e161f6dcca14&_e=1MGwY5Zx6acza00zEcGCWHNJVDMnsNiWxNOLPb834jviYJDTpOax5qHx2om4dUQPC0e84iZSPl0NHOMLrWyQFJ3hTSdUKhVC9ucBXSvEAdlp4T7h5kgi8XwIJ2sjY_-tMAoWmr9QSKry9JGAMJZ5WbdBr1Qijx2kvisXT71WsDkLbo0_cayNhe0-NC5p50FbiPCkkkOAmkAoFGcmLDjc2HWqnOC0A1YiKkokSrSFBDtG3vKf0p7vWVoTH2Sl_wu1DSxl_6r_08GpaVNLoOfDcesBHtlmlANzx2AGkkJgxMY%3D)
Friend,

Whenever you read the news these days, do you feel like you're living through Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_?
* Supply chain breakdowns
* Surging inflation
* Spiking crime
* Capitalism and entrepreneurs under attack
* Greedy politicians
* **And everyone is just waiting for _somebody else_ to fix these problems!**

_What happened to the productive individuals who make the world a better place? Have they already withdrawn to some Galt 's Gulch somewhere? Or do they need to be reminded of man's heroic nature?_

Where there is a crisis, there is also an opportunity -- one which The Atlas Society is aggressively seizing.

I'm Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society. Our content and our world-class faculty of scholars promote the principles of Ayn Rand's philosophy of Objectivism, as dramatized in such works as her epic novel _Atlas Shrugged_ and her brilliant non-fiction essays.

**The younger generation needs to hear about the philosophy of man as a heroic being, with reason as his only means of survival and productive achievement as his noblest activity.**

Otherwise, Ayn Rand's novel ceases to be a _warning_ and becomes a _reality_.

As Rand herself reminds us: "_Atlas Shrugged_ is not a prophecy of our unavoidable destruction, but a manifesto of our power to avoid it, if we choose to change our course."

Our largest creative venture is turning Ayn Rand's famous novels and screenplays into graphic novels to reach new audiences with her philosophy. **Graphic novels are the only genre among young people where readership is growing.**

One mom told me, _" I've been trying to get my son to read Ayn Rand, and he won't do it... but he'll read a graphic novel!"_

_If you want to influence the next generation, you have to meet them where they are -- and by using visually appealing books and social media, we are doing just that_. That means moving past dry, dense volumes of philosophically rooted text by adding images and action that make these ideas more vibrant and REAL to young readers.

As Ayn Rand herself observed, _" Art is the indispensable medium for the communication of a moral ideal."_

The best way to get Ayn Rand's moral ideas to more students is by distributing copies of these graphic novels at Comic Cons, libraries, and homeschool groups.

Last year, we distributed 75,000 copies of our graphic novel versions of Ayn Rand's _ANTHEM_ and _Red Pawn_. **And the current demand is exceeding our supply!**

Supply chain breakdowns Surging inflation Spiking crime Capitalism and entrepreneurs under attack Greedy politicians And everyone is just waiting for somebody else to fix these problems! What happened to the productive individuals who make the world a better place? Have they already withdrawn to some Galt 's Gulch somewhere? Or do they need to be reminded of man's heroic nature? Where there is a crisis, there is also an opportunity -- one which The Atlas Society is aggressively seizing. I'm Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society. Our content and our world-class faculty of scholars promote the principles of Ayn Rand's philosophy of Objectivism, as dramatized in such works as her epic novel Atlas Shrugged and her brilliant non-fiction essays. Sheriff Mark Lamb is a husband, father, grandfather, and God-fearing patriot. From Hawaii to Manila, Arizona, Mark Lamb's rich experirences inspired his life of service. As the 24th Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona, he drives a powerful agenda to ensure community safety and prosperity.

Sheriff Lamb trained with the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office Deputy Academy and was named Valedictorian of his class. He was hired by the Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community, where he excelled as a police officer and was named Rookie of the Year. The following year, he received the Officer of the Year award. Thanks to President Biden and Vice President Harris, we’ve made historic progress over the last few years: 13 million jobs created. Lowered prescription drug costs for seniors. Historic investments in our clean energy future. I’m damn proud of the work we’ve done together.
Now, all of that progress is on the line. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States. I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country. I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A. I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I’m running for President because we have a country to save! I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor” because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. And I’ll do it as your next President. It’s Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy writing to you from Montana this afternoon.
