After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Hi Peter, As we rapidly approach our next FEC filing deadline, we wanted to share a few quick numbers to paint a picture of this campaign:
* **$38.65:** Our average online donation in August
* **$10,000:** The maximum amount a corporate PAC can donate to a candidate
* **258:** The number of $38.65 donations we need to match a corporate max-out gift

The truth is, it's an uphill battle to run a people-powered campaign when your opponent is bringing in $10,000 donations from the likes of Raytheon, Lockheed Martin, and Boeing. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. From a young age, I’ve appreciated the power of strong unions. When my father joined the UAW, our family got healthcare for the first time and he learned what human dignity felt like in the workplace.

clean_body: We’re building a government that works for working-class people rather than billionaires. | | | Friend, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and I have been joining picket lines to support striking workers, including UAW workers on strike now across the country. When my father joined the UAW, we got healthcare for the first time. And when Alexandria supported her family by working as a waitress and bartender, she lived without health insurance or dignity in the workplace. The fight for workers’ rights is personal for both of us, which is why AOC and I are legislating with the urgency that working-class communities deserve. While CEOs and billionaires are making record profits, workers are struggling to put food on the table and stay in their homes. This is an unacceptable and unjust status quo, so we’re building the power needed to change it. As we fight for working people and marginalized communities, we’re up against billionaires and greedy corporations who seek to silence us, attack our rights, and maintain their obscene profits on the backs of workers. This Saturday is an urgent end-of-quarter fundraising deadline after which we’ll report to the Federal Election Commission how much we’ve raised and spent, and how much cash on hand we have for the fight ahead. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, split evenly between Rashida Tlaib and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez | | | | | | | | | | Please feel free to check out yesterday’s email for more information about some of the workers’ rights legislation we’ve led in Congress. Our teams have also been training everyday people about how to unionize and how to protect people’s right to strike. We’re committed to this struggle alongside you and working-class people everywhere. In solidarity, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Tue, Sep 26, 2023 Subject: Justice for working-class people: To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, From a young age, I’ve appreciated the power of strong unions. When my father joined the UAW, our family got healthcare for the first time and he learned what human dignity felt like in the workplace. Now, most people in our country are living paycheck to paycheck, and UAW workers are on strike, joining workers rising up across the country to say: Enough with corporate greed. Enough with crumbs when CEOs are being paid record salaries. My sister-in-service Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has worked as a bartender and a waitress to make ends meet. Because of her personal experiences living without health insurance or dignity in the workplace, AOC understands how urgently and boldly we must fight for economic justice. And that’s exactly what we’re doing in Congress. As we fight for workers’ rights and fight back against attacks on marginalized communities, we’re under attack by those who seek to maintain an unjust status quo. The millionaire and billionaire class seek to silence us—women of color who have the lived experiences of millions of working and low-income people across the country. No worker should be exploited, retaliated against, or denied benefits—especially for organizing for better working conditions and a better quality of life. Alexandra is co-sponsoring legislation I just re-introduced to secure rights for restaurant workers—which would protect the right to unionize without fear of retaliation, raise the $2.13/hour federal tipped minimum wage to a livable wage, ensure paid leave and healthcare coverage, and more. I’ve been proud to join AOC’s fight for a Green New Deal to expand good union jobs. And AOC was by my side when I led legislation to tax big corporations that pay their CEOs and other top executives at least 50 times more than they pay an average worker. That disparity is what we’re seeing with the Big Three automakers, where CEOs are making about 365 times the pay of their average employee. While the rich keep getting richer, workers are struggling to put food on the table and stay in their homes. This system is unjust, but we’re building the power needed to change it. Team – Before coming to Congress, I spent my entire career as a labor advocate and trade unionist, and I know firsthand just how important and impactful labor strikes are. | _Thanks so much for being on Team Sarah! I wanted to take a few minutes out of the day to share some questions I get when talking to people, but I have to admit this email is pretty long._ _**If you’re just looking for a place to donate before our big quarterly deadline on Saturday,[click here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70464513/429451618/1846669455?refcode=EM_FL_MCB_20230927_fr_eoq2_cand_nc_90da_xx_boxlink&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZGIxYzU1My02ODVkLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rKsnLVoSjmtqsFN0gAf5R1qX4o2Bz7ILTBf3ryVLWpo=) or on any of the links or buttons below.** (And then forward this email to someone you think might be interested in our campaign!)_
---

**I’ve always been one to believe that nothing is truly impossible. But I don’t have blind hope, either. I’m a realist.**
When you’re trans — or a woman, Black or Brown, an immigrant, queer, poor, differently abled — you have to work _that much harder_ to achieve what others appear to do so effortlessly.
That includes running for Congress.
**But sometimes when I talk to people, some people think my candidacy is inevitable... while others question the viability of a trans candidate.**
Before I ask you to [chip in to our most important fundraising deadline](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70464514/429451619/1846669455?refcode=EM_FL_MCB_20230927_fr_eoq2_cand_nc_90da_xx_l1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZGIxYzU1My02ODVkLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rKsnLVoSjmtqsFN0gAf5R1qX4o2Bz7ILTBf3ryVLWpo=) (it actually is!) of the campaign, I want to directly address some of the questions I get when I talk to people:

# I saw a poll that said you’re ahead. What are you worried about?
There are two things you should always remember when you read a poll:
**First, polls aren’t votes!** They’re more like taking the temperature of a population at any given time. Polls get at how people are feeling at the moment they pick up that phone call or answer that text from a pollster and share their opinion. Nothing more, nothing less.
**Second, getting people out to vote is actually pretty hard.** It takes real organizing, follow-ups and following through, and reminding people why elections matter. Because when it comes down to the first Tuesday in September, people are more likely to be preoccupied with kids going back to school, what’s for dinner, or even thinking about the Presidential election, not this one.

# Can a trans candidate actually win?
No matter what the polls say and no matter how many times we’ve proven the naysayers wrong, **I continue to hear more cynical political observers question whether Delaware is ready for someone like me. They doubt a trans candidate can win**. The data, the response, and the fair-mindedness of voters have proven time and time again how wrong this is, but the best way we can continue to show what’s possible is to demonstrate our strength and support.
If we continue to do that, I’m confident that we can show young people across our small state — and around the country — that our democracy is big enough for them too.

# I’ve seen pictures of you at packed events. Don’t you have a lot of support?
I do! And I’m so proud to have earned the trust of so many Delawareans both as a candidate and as a legislator.
At every step of the way, my ability to win an election or pass a transformative piece of legislation has been because the great people of this great state had my back.
**But this is an open seat and a statewide campaign. Our campaign will likely be attacked by right-wing outlets and outside groups spending money against us.**

# You raised a lot of money. Why do you need my donation?
It takes a lot of money to win an election. It really shouldn't be that way – but our campaign is going to have to outraise everyone in the field by quite a lot.
**We’re taking on extra costs because it’s important to me to talk to voters in every corner of our state.** We’re already organizing events, knocking on doors, and building a mass volunteer program, months ahead of most Congressional campaigns.
**This one is tough for me to say, but it’s the truth: Because I’m often a target of right-wing attacks, our campaign pays for things most other campaigns don’t.** Making sure everyone is safe is frankly more important to me than winning, but that can come along with extra expenses, too.

# I want to help. How can I?
**If you can walk away from this email with one thing, I hope it’s this: I need you on my team. Today. Tomorrow. And a year from now. In whatever way you’re able.**
**Right now, donating to our campaign before midnight on Saturday is the single most important thing you can do. I really mean it.[So, if you can, chip in right now:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70464515/429451620/1846669455?refcode=EM_FL_MCB_20230927_fr_eoq2_cand_nc_90da_xx_l2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjI0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZGIxYzU1My02ODVkLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rKsnLVoSjmtqsFN0gAf5R1qX4o2Bz7ILTBf3ryVLWpo=)**

Team,
Yesterday, Sara emailed you about our $4,000 goal for the end of the quarter, and we want to give you some insight into how your dollars will fund the resources needed for her re-election campaign.

(And if you didn’t get a chance yesterday to donate, click here to chip in whatever you can to help us hit our goal.) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Ask any campaign staffer about the most important elements of a winning campaign and they’ll likely tell you three things:
1. Time
2. Money
3. People power

Serving as a Member of Congress and running for re-election is like having two full-time jobs. For Sara, this means she’s meeting with her constituents, drafting legislation and defending it on the House floor, attending important committee hearings, and more – and she’s in full campaign mode.

There aren’t enough hours in the day for Sara to be everywhere at once, which is why it also takes money and people power to run and win next November. That looks like:

-Hiring campaign staff (hi!) to reach every voter and speak to the diverse communities that make up her district.

-Running a home base office in the district for all the campaign work, including electricity, desks, and coffee for the late-night sprints as we get closer to election day.

-Designing, printing, and mailing voting reminders so that every voter knows when and how to vote.

-Investing in online voter outreach from a website to online advertising to social media to emails just like this one.

And so much more.

If we’re going to re-elect Sara and retake the House in 2024, we need to raise funds, staff up our campaign, and train volunteers early on so we can map out a winning strategy. There’s a lot of planning that will happen in the days and weeks ahead, but none of it is possible without your help - especially ahead of a major deadline like this one on September 30th.

Thanks so much!

It’s yet another tactic the GOP uses to try to maintain power when they’re worried they can’t win on the popularity of their policies alone. So what do we do? **We fight back.** We’re not just getting ready in the last weeks leading up to any election – we’ve been working up to this moment for months now, organizing to register new voters, ensuring voters know and where to vote (and their rights while doing so!), and utilizing every tool at our disposal in the process. | | Dear Watchers, Supporters, and all of you who care about America becoming more EQUAL FOR ALL, First and foremost, I'm proud to say that our campaign is fueled by the power of the people. We've placed a strong emphasis on grassroots donations because we believe that the voice of every individual matters, regardless of the size of their contribution. This not only ensures that our campaign remains independent, but it also aligns with our commitment to inclusive and equitable representation. I'm uniquely positioned as the only candidate who represents the intersection of being a woman of color and a member of the LGBTQ+ community. Positioned to make history as the 1st African-European American elected to Congress for Orange County and for our goals of a more equitable America and O.C. THIS IS OUR CHANCE. THIS IS OUR OPPORTUNITY FOR REAL CHANGE. This resonates deeply with those who are passionate about advancing equal rights and social progress. We anticipate robust support from organizations that champion these values, recognizing that our campaign embodies the kind of inclusive leadership our nation needs. In addition to this, we expect to receive funding from various equal rights groups, environmental advocacy organizations, and those dedicated to achieving true equity and equality. These groups recognize that our campaign is not just about winning an election, but about championing the values and policies that will shape a brighter and more inclusive future for our nation. Our message, rooted in justice, equality, and progress, has struck a chord with individuals and organizations alike. It's a testament to the fact that people are yearning for authentic leadership that genuinely reflects their values and aspirations. We trust that this groundswell of support will carry us forward and allow us to run a campaign that truly represents the voices and needs of our community. Together, we are building a movement that transcends partisan lines and brings us closer to the America we all envision – one where every person, regardless of their background, can thrive and be heard. With the generous support of individuals, organizations, and grassroots donors, we're confident that we will meet, reach and engage with as many constituents as possible. I love you all, and I am doing this for us all.With Love, Dom Jones

body:
We wanted to make sure you saw this
# [](https://act.losecruzpac.com/go/128?t=1&akid=102%2E623276%2ErWagkC)
It’s been _three_ months since we first launched our grassroots campaign to Lose Ted Cruz once and for all. Since then, we’ve expanded our movement, built a winning campaign strategy, and held Ted accountable for his (many) outlandish antics.
And while Ted probably isn’t looking forward to Election Day next November, we certainly are.
But if we’re going to stay competitive in light of the millions the GOP will spend to defend Ted’s seat, we’ll need to continue expanding our grassroots coalition to send Ted home.
You can read more about the current state of the U.S. Senate race in Texas below (it may surprise you!) but with just three days left until our very _first_ end-of-quarter fundraising deadline, **[can you pitch in $5 or anything you can afford to part ways with our part-time senator?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lc-20230927?refcode=em20230927&amount=5&refcode2=102_623276_rWagkC&akid=102%2E623276%2ErWagkC)**
Thank you so much!
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Lose Cruz HQ** [info@e.losecruzpac.com]
Date: Mon, Sept 18, 2023 at 3:00 PM
Subject: What if we told you?

Not so long ago, there was a time where the very idea of Ted Cruz losing reelection seemed nothing more than some far-off fever dream.
_**But that was then, and this is now.**_
What if we told you...
* In 2018, Ted won reelection but only by _just_ 2.6 percentage points — the closest U.S. Senate race in Texas since 1978.
* CNN recently named Texas as one of 10 Senate seats **_most likely to flip_** next year.
* **_Nearly half_** of Texas voters have a “somewhat” or “very unfavorable” view of their part-time senator.
* There are now not just one, two, but _three_ amazing Democratic candidates seeking to send Ted home — one of which, Colin Allred is polling 5 points behind Cruz.

There are only 413 days left until the 2024 election and we have the unique opportunity to break up with our part-time senator for good. But if we’re going to succeed and win, we can’t do this without you.
**[Can you make a $5 contribution today to bring us one step closer to losing Cruz next year?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lc-20230927?refcode=em20230927&amount=5&refcode2=102_623276_rWagkC&akid=102%2E623276%2ErWagkC)**

Thank you! We're grateful to have you on this team!
In solidarity,
— LCHQ

Dear Peter, Our campaign is facing a critical deadline on Saturday, September 30th! name: LCV Conservation Team
subject: Our campaign to protect the Arctic is WORKING, Peter. Take action now to finish the job.
body:
Voice Your Support For Protecting America's Arctic |
---
| | **Voice Your Support For Protecting America 's Arctic**

President Biden has just _canceled_ all remaining oil and gas leases in the Arctic Refuge. Now, the public has the opportunity to weigh in on the future of oil and gas development in the Arctic Refuge and strengthening protections for more than 13 million acres in the Western Arctic.

Please, take a moment to [add your name to thank President Biden and Secretary Haaland and urge them to support maximum protections for the Arctic.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fb0~__)
|
---
**[**TAKE ACTION NOW**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fb0~__)**

** **
|
Peter -- This September, President Biden announced that he'd cancel _all remaining oil and gas leases issued by former President Trump in the Arctic Refuge._

**This is huge news for our movement. With your help, LCV has fought long and hard to protect the Arctic in the face of fierce opposition from the oil and gas industry.******

That's not all: President Biden and Interior Secretary Deb Haaland have also announced two new opportunities for the public to weigh in. The first is a proposal to strengthen protections for 13 million acres in the Western Arctic. These proposed protections are vitally important for this unique and sacred landscape and would build on efforts to permanently protect the Arctic region. The second opportunity is a chance to weigh in on the future of oil and gas development in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge. The Refuge is home to the Gwich'in nation, as well as a vast array of species, including caribou, bears, migratory birds, and tundra vegetation like mosses and lichens. Any proposed oil and gas development must consider all potential impacts to the lands, water, wildlife, communities, and climate in this sacred area.

This isn't a done deal yet, Peter. We need your help to keep the momentum going. [Please, take a moment to thank both President Biden and Secretary Haaland and tell them to finish the job by finalizing the strongest possible protections for the Arctic. It only takes a minute -- add your name right now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fb0~__)

The cancellation of the illegally held leases in the Arctic Refuge will restore lands that are both sacred to the Indigenous Gwich'in people and are vital to the health of the Arctic ecosystem. **And it wouldn 't be possible without _your_ tireless advocacy,** combined with the voices of Indigenous and other communities in Alaska who have fought these illegal leases.

This is just one step towards permanent protection for one of the planet's most vulnerable landscapes. We can't afford to let up until the Arctic is safe from climate-killing oil and gas development -- both now and in the future.

[Your voice can make a real difference as the Biden administration weighs important protections for the Arctic. Add your name to our petition now to thank President Biden and Secretary Haaland and tell them to finalize the strongest possible protections >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fb0~__)

Thank you for taking action for our planet's future.

Onward,

LCV Conservation Team |

---

Peter Willis — for as long as I can remember, the billionaire class has treated elections like just another one of their playgrounds.

But candidates like Barbara Lee are changing that.

Every day, working Americans are getting more and more fed up with the rich and powerful skipping out on their fair share of taxes while so many struggle to keep a roof over their heads. They want a leader that looks out for them — not just the interests of the 1%.

So when they hear about Rep. Lee's record on income inequality — like the bill she co-sponsored that would ensure the wealthiest Americans pay at least a 20% income tax — they're won over by this historic grassroots movement that she is building.

Barbara Lee is ready to stand up for working people — but this race is close. She needs your support to reach voters across the state, so I'm asking:

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

name: Courier News
subject: AP: RNC’s livestreaming partner for GOP debate is a haven for disinformation and extremism
body:
The ‘alt’ video-sharing platform has long been accused of being a disinformation mill.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1632%2E120351%2EQI-ng3)
Peter, take a look at this headline:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230927?refcode=em20230927&amount=5&refcode2=1632_120351_QI-ng3&akid=1632%2E120351%2EQI-ng3)
Fox is broadcasting tonight’s GOP debate, but the exclusive online livestream will take place on Rumble — an “alternative” video-sharing platform that has long been a hub for far-right extremism, white supremacy, election disinformation, and conspiracy theories.
[**In a moment, we’ll explain more about Rumble, but before we do, can you chip in anything you can so we fight back against the right-wing disinformation that will inevitably come out of tonight’s debate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230927?refcode=em20230927&amount=5&refcode2=1632_120351_QI-ng3&akid=1632%2E120351%2EQI-ng3)
So, what exactly is Rumble?
Rumble is a video-sharing platform that positions itself as a conservative alternative to YouTube.
Rumble prides itself on being “immune to cancel culture.” Users upload tons of videos that violate the content standards of mainstream social media platforms, including content that denies the 2020 election results and promotes bigoted views on race and gender.
A 2022 analysis from News Guard — an organization that monitors online misinformation — found that **nearly _half_ of the videos suggested by Rumble in response to searches for common election-related keywords came from uncredible sources.**
In livestreaming tonight’s debate on Rumble, the RNC is knowingly driving voters to a platform where hate and propaganda spread. As we saw in 2016 and in the aftermath of the 2020 election, bad information can spread beyond social media platforms like Rumble and into communities that don’t have access to news sources they can trust.
At Courier Newsroom, our innovative model is keenly focused on combating this problem. We report the truth, no matter what, and we bring that truth to vulnerable communities without paywalls or subscription fees.
But if we’re going to continue to be on the frontlines of fighting back against disinformation mills like Rumble, we’ll need your help, Peter. [**If you can, will you pitch in today to power Democracy’s Newsroom and the fact-based, reliable journalism behind it?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230927?refcode=em20230927&amount=5&refcode2=1632_120351_QI-ng3&akid=1632%2E120351%2EQI-ng3)

Thank you!

A 2022 analysis from News Guard — an organization that monitors online misinformation — found that nearly half of the videos suggested by Rumble in response to searches for common election-related keywords came from uncredible sources. In livestreaming tonight’s debate on Rumble, the RNC is knowingly driving voters to a platform where hate and propaganda spread. As we saw in 2016 and in the aftermath of the 2020 election, bad information can spread beyond social media platforms like Rumble and into communities that don’t have access to news sources they can trust. At Courier Newsroom, our innovative model is keenly focused on combating this problem. We report the truth, no matter what, and we bring that truth to vulnerable communities without paywalls or subscription fees. But if we’re going to continue to be on the frontlines of fighting back against disinformation mills like Rumble, we’ll need your help, Peter. Thank you! — Courier Newsroom Email us: mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com

subject: Your Signature is Needed: Five decades of environmental protections rolled back to favor polluters
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015641?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Protect people and the planet from polluting projects! [Sign the petition to REVERSE Trump’s rollback on bedrock environmental protections>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015642?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** **Friend,** can you imagine **fossil fuel** sites in your backyard, **smokestacks** close to your children’s school and playground, and **toxic waste** being disposed in nearby public water sources? Thankfully, you may be protected from the overwhelming damage caused by Big Oil and Gas and their selfish decisions, _but for others this is a scary reality._

Without the **National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA),** the location of polluting projects is left to be decided by greedy corporations who will not think _twice_ about the communities they occupy and impact. NEPA has historically stood as a critical tool in addressing climate concerns through _community feedback, equitable solutions, and corporate regulation._ But in 2020, critical protections in this law were **_REMOVED_** , leaving communities and residents unprotected from Big Polluters’ dirty deals.

**Right now, President Biden is modifying NEPA rules which means YOU can speak up for the future of our planet.** [_**Can we count on your voice, Friend? Sign the petition to tell President Biden to restore bedrock environmental protections that could SAVE people and the planet >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015643?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015644?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
The consequences from the fossil fuel industry do not only cause _irreversible_ damage to the planet, but also to human health. Communities near fossil fuel projects, more often Black, Brown, Indigenous, and low-income neighborhoods, are subjected to **consuming contaminated water, inhaling toxins and fumes, and suffer from blistering headaches.** Severe health conditions linked to pollutants can range from _**asthma to CANCER.**_

**President Biden can restore this law and protect people’s health and the planet.** [_**Strengthening NEPA could mean creating a clean, just, and sustainable future. This is possible, but we need your help Friend! Add your name before 11:59pm TONIGHT to fight toxic pollution in our communities >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015645?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2015646?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

clean_body: your donation matters more than you know | | | Derek, I’m sure you know the deal by now when it comes to these end-of-quarter deadlines – after every four months, we have to file our fundraising numbers with the Federal Election Commission – who then makes our numbers publicly available. It’s important we hit our fundraising goals for every end-of-quarter deadline, but frankly, this one carries a bit more weight than usual. Since this is our final deadline before the legislative elections in Virginia, our numbers are going to dictate how much money the GOP decides to pour into the Commonwealth to support Republican candidates before Election Day. That’s why we’ve set an ambitious fundraising goal to close out this quarter: $15,000. **= Republicans nationwide are already pouring crazy amounts of money into Virginia. The biggest Republican PAC in Virginia has been shattering fundraising records and just last week it was reported that $1.4 million of dark money has been spent in an effort to elect GOP candidates to the General Assembly. It’s pretty simple. # **FedNow The Start of Biden’s Digital Dollar**

|
---
| | [](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jr3OnDAQRZ9m6IzG4z9cUCQhpEoRaXd7Yxuw1uwiYIV4-wgSfVPO3DvnuGnOqT9qMN-BaExhBSIQ34Dos4mHu99_Lwcbqor9Ug8aziP9AKLtmONX8v-TMk4u5XNrmiLUkhzvfRFrrq2qpEVZFWOtjfdYOUvKVr0LKIWjGFFh1xuvtStSTUgCLRniHKUqiWukYFwnpLHUWZB4gcp-iXEb0-sZl-BSPkr_nopcj9s2r5dYC9Tu-14O7xzS4p5pY1eT8fnMArVd_kSmuSUBol17nwKIxiD_M-I5_HYXLyCdVxANImc_r3q7xMhu_8isOdFA2r9ANJVSTEvJNHFVLHWY95RzWrUBicMl7d_T3wAAAP__5PJtHA)
---
| | On July 20th, 2023, the Federal Reserve launched _FedNow_ , which could spark the fuse for a Digital Dollar. If a Digital Dollar happens, the government could:
---
* Monitor every transaction...
* Keep track of your spending habits...
* And potentially control your individual choices...

---
Which MAY steal your freedoms in one way or another. **And if you don’t plan for this now...**
---
| | **Your retirement savings could be at risk of being frozen, hacked, or deleted.**
---

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
The Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline is Saturday, and I want to tell you why these deadlines are different than the others.
FEC quarterly deadlines are required by law and only happen four times a year. Afterward, we have to file a finance report with the FEC. The numbers on our final report reflect the resources we have for turning out the vote in Texas and flipping the House in Washington.
As Campaign Treasurer, I keep a close eye on our numbers and I’m happy to report that we’re making great progress toward our Q3 goal! We need to keep up our momentum, and these deadlines are a team effort. Any amount you can contribute would help a lot. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230927?refcode=folf230927]
The Texas primary is less than six months away, and three people have filed to run against Lizzie.
We’ll need to talk to voters in Harris and Fort Bend counties—just like we have in past elections—about the great job Lizzie is doing for our district in Congress, like her efforts to lower prescription drug costs and to protect access to reproductive health care.
We’ll do that by sending mail, running ads, putting up yard signs, and knocking on doors.
Every contribution supports those efforts, and I’d really appreciate whatever you can spare ahead of Saturday’s deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/folf230927?refcode=folf230927]
Thank you for your support!
Gordon Center

I lost my father to gun violence when I was just 24 years old.

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep23-dmp.eCZ2XI&refcode=em230927-2-15&t=1&akid=6649%2E3935704%2EWHtRh9)
---
Hi there, my name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m the Democrat running for Senate in Florida to defeat Rick Scott. This race is bigger than just one state—winning would make a big difference in the Senate, where our gun safety majority is razor thin.
I’m running because Floridians deserve a leader who will put them first and keep them safe. Rick Scott has proven time and time again that he will side with the gun lobby instead of keeping his constituents safe. It’s time to send him packing, but I need your help to defeat him.
[**If you’re ready to chip in to help me retire Rick Scott, please click here to split a contribution between my campaign and GIFFORDS PAC before Saturday’s FEC deadline.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep23-dmp.eCZ2XI&refcode=em230927-2-15&t=2&akid=6649%2E3935704%2EWHtRh9)
The fight to end gun violence is personal to me. I lost my father to gun violence when I was just 24 years old. The trauma and pain you feel when you lose a loved one in this way is inexplicable and lasts forever.
This tragedy has shaped my work to fight for a future where our communities are safe from gun violence. It’s work that I started as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives and as a GIFFORDS adviser. As Florida’s next Senator, gun safety will remain one of my top legislative priorities.
I need to ask for your help today. The first end-of-quarter deadline of my campaign is in less than three days, and right now we’re $32,119 short of my $350,000 goal.

Kat Cammack, the youngest Republican woman in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack, now in her second term, sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

REPORT: Jim Durkin Removed from Speakers List During U.S. House Judiciary Hearing in Chicago After his Vote in Favor of the Assault Weapons Ban was Discovered (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/report-jim-durkin-removed-from-speakers-list-during-u-s-house-judiciary-hearing-in-chicago-after-his-vote-in-favor-of-the-assault-weapons-ban-was-discovered.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/report-jim-durkin-removed-from-speakers-list-during-u-s-house-judiciary-hearing-in-chicago-after-his-vote-in-favor-of-the-assault-weapons-ban-was-discovered.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former Ill. House Republican leader Jim Durkin of Western Springs. (Source: Screen Image from BlueRoomStream)
On Tuesday, the U.S. House Judiciary Committee held a special hearing (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/rep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) on “Victims of Violent Crime in Chicago,” as witnesses testified about failed Democratic policies, the violent crime plaguing the city and the lack of political support for local police officers. Three witnesses testified before the committee, but as a report on Wednesday revealed – there was one witness missing: former Illinois House Republican leader Jim Durkin.

In Wednesday’s edition of POLITICO’s
Illinois Playbook (https://www.politico.com/newsletters/illinoisplaybook?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , it was reported that Durkin – who attended Tuesday’s hearing at Chicago FOP Lodge #7 and was a strong opponent of the SAFE-T ACT when he was in the Illinois legislature, “had initially been set to testify but was taken off the speaker list when organizers got wind of his OpEd (https://chicago.suntimes.com/2023/6/19/23763400/assault-weapons-ban-illinois-second-amendment-mass-shootings-guns-jim-durkin-op-ed?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D#:~:text=At%20the%20close%20of%20the,for%20the%20safety%20of%20Illinoisans.) supporting an assault weapons ban.”

In January, before he resigned from the Illinois legislature, Durkin was the only Republican to join the Democrats,
voting (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=00000185-8628-de44-a7bf-ee3f47b80000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in favor of the assault weapons ban (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/breaking-il-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin-votes-with-democrats-to-ban-assault-weapons.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a move that angered conservatives and supporters of the 2nd Amendment, who vehemently opposed the unconstitutional weapons ban.

During the 2022 midterm election, Durkin suffered embarrassing losses, giving Democrats once again, supermajority control in the Illinois House.

In an interview with the
Chicago Tribune (https://www.chicagotribune.com/politics/ct-jim-durkin-resigning-house-seat-20230108-f6f6lkonprdsnmdlzmz3vhc4im-story.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) after the election, Durkin blamed the Second Amendment (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/breaking-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin-resigning-says-trump-republicans-2nd-amendment-and-pro-life-issues-dragged-gop-down-in-midterm-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and social issues like abortion for Republican losses this past November.

Durkin remains a close ally and best friend of IL GOP chairman Don Tracy. During the primary, Durkin was a
supporter (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=0000017e-6d5c-dbc8-a1ff-7d7dbf990000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) of Richard Irvin’s Republican campaign for governor, despite Irvin pulling Democratic Primary ballots (https://twitter.com/markmaxwelltv/status/1471589397552320517?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in 2014, 2016 and 2020.

Rumors are swirling in political circles that Durkin is thinking about running for Cook County State’s Attorney after Kim Foxx announced in April that she won’t run for re-election.

Rep. Jim Jordan, House Judiciary Committee, Hold Emotional Hearing at Chicago FOP on "Victims of Violent Crime," Blames "Left Wing Policies" on Rise in Crime (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/rep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/09/rep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Members of the U.S. House Judiciary Committee during a hearing at the Chicago FOP Lodge #7 on Tuesday, September 26, 2023. (Source: X/Chicago FOP)
In a packed room at the Fraternal Order of Police Chicago Lodge #7 on Tuesday, Republican chairman U.S. Rep. Jim Jordan, R-OH and the House Judiciary Committee held a hearing on “Victims of Violent Crime in Chicago” as witnesses including Gianno Caldwell, a family member of a murder victim; Lt. John Garrido III, a retired Chicago Police Detective and Carlos Yanez, Jr., a retired Chicago Police Officer who was seriously wounded while on-duty during a traffic stop, testified about the violent crime plaguing the city and the lack of support for the police.
https://www.youtube.com/live/SgAgEocfkQo?si=Iyk12pv-5l7SEcOU&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, R-OH, holds a committee hearing on “Victims of Violent Crime in Chicago” on Tuesday, September 26, 2023 at Chicago FOP Lodge #7.
Yanez’ partner, Ella French, was shot and killed during the traffic incident.

“When you let bad guys stay on the street, you shouldnt be surprised when you get more crime; when you defund the police, you shouldn’t be surprised when you get more crime; when you pass legislation that ends cash bail, you shouldn’t be surprised when you get more crime – and when you do all those things, you shouldn’t be surprised that we have, what, a 1,700 police officer shortage in the city. That’s what left wing policies have done,” said House Judiciary Chairman Jim Jordan.
https://twitter.com/Jim_Jordan/status/1706687502877184414?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1706687502877184414%7Ctwgr%5Efdc257d6aada53867165ed9e320a300920d658ea%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Frep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Gianno Caldwell, who was born and raised on the south side of Chicago, lost his 18-year old brother Christian in 2022. Christian was murdered and his killers are still out on the streets.

Caldwell blamed the policies of Chicago Mayor’s Lori Lightfoot and Brandon Johnson, Gov. JB Pritzker, Cook County State’s Attorney Kim Foxx and other politicians for failing to address the rise in violent crimes.

“These officials have recklessly ignored the people they were elected to represent. And as a result, bodies – mostly black bodies, are littered throughout the streets of Chicago.”

Caldwell then spoke painfully about the moment in 2022 when he received a call that his “innocent, teenaged baby brother Christian” had been murdered.
https://twitter.com/JudiciaryGOP/status/1706683920157147442?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1706683920157147442%7Ctwgr%5Efdc257d6aada53867165ed9e320a300920d658ea%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Frep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Retired Chicago Police Lt. John Garrido III testified about the “adverse effects of politics on law enforcement in Chicago,” and referred to police officers as “pawns in a larger political game forced to enforce laws and policies that may not necessarily serve the best interest of our community and public safety.”

Garrido also spoke about the long term damaging effects of the “defund the police movement,” that resulted in a “police department that is both underfunded and understaffed, compromising our ability to serve and protect.”
https://twitter.com/JudiciaryGOP/status/1706685216197091393?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1706685216197091393%7Ctwgr%5Efdc257d6aada53867165ed9e320a300920d658ea%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Frep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Retired Chicago Police Officer Carlos Yanez, Jr. testified about “policies and procedures put into place” by Democratic leaders that lead to officers feeling like “their hands are tied behind their back” – unable to do their jobs and protect the public.

Yanez suffers from long term effects from the shooting, which took the life of his partner, as he explained during the hearing.

“I was shot a total of 5 times, 4 of which were in the head; I lost my right eye, some of my hearing in both ears. I also have tinnitus in my right ear as well as partially paralyzed on the right side of my body.”
https://twitter.com/JudiciaryGOP/status/1706682136684589523?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1706682136684589523%7Ctwgr%5Efdc257d6aada53867165ed9e320a300920d658ea%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.illinoisreview.com%2Fillinoisreview%2F2023%2F09%2Frep-jim-jordan-house-judiciary-committee-hold-emotional-hearing-at-chicago-fop-on-victims-of-violent-crime-blames-left-wing-policies-on-rise-in-crime.html&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
State’s Attorney Kim Foxx released a statement (https://abc7chicago.com/house-judiciary-committee-chicago-crime-republicans-government-shutdown/13828532/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) prior to the hearing, in which she blamed guns, saying,

“As the nation is on the verge of a Republican sponsored government shutdown, Jim Jordan has chosen to come to Chicago rather than fulfill his obligations to his constituents. Instead of focusing on the victims of mass shootings caused by weak gun protection laws including his own district, he has chosen to spend his time with John Catanzara – the man who in the immediate aftermath of January 6th, proclaimed it to be a peaceful protest.”

Foxx concluded with,

“Jim Jordan is seeking to exploit the deaths of black and brown victims of crime, rather than supporting common sense gun legislation...”

The Illinois State Rifle Association issued a
statement (https://isra.org/us_comm_statement/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) immediately following the hearing.

“As Chicago crime statistics continue to dominate national headlines, Cook County State’s Attorney Kim Foxx continues to deflect any responsibility – and instead chooses to blame ‘weak gun protection laws’ instead of the violent criminals who to this day, continue to roam the streets of Chicago targeting innocent victims.

Since 2021, nearly 250 attorneys have resigned from Kim Foxx’s office out of frustration because of her failure to hold violent criminals accountable for their crimes. And as a result, victims’ families are suffering, and the criminals are celebrating.

In Illinois, Democrats like Gov. JB Pritzker and Kim Foxx have declared war on the 2nd Amendment and are deliberately targeting law-abiding citizens and their lawful right to bear arms – blaming the guns for the crimes rather than the criminals committing them.”
https://isra.org/us_comm_statement/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The ISRA then thanked Rep. Jordan and the committee for holding the hearing as well as members of the Chicago Police Department for their sacrifices.

“We applaud U.S. Rep. Jim Jordan and the House Judiciary Committee for coming to Chicago and shining a light on the violent crime plaguing the city, and we remain grateful to the brave police officers who put their lives on the line each day under such difficult circumstances.”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=37c8df6f5e-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_09_27_04_27&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-37c8df6f5e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: Are you ready to fight like hell?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF DAN KILDEE
body:
Friend, We are facing an unprecedented, historic moment for democracy. What’s more, MAGA extremists aren’t backing down from their efforts to roll back progress we have made together against all odds. There are so many moments from the last few years where it has felt like everything was on the line. When the Supreme Court voted to turn back the clock and overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , a right afforded to Americans for nearly 50 years was stripped away. It horrified me to think that my daughters would have fewer rights than I did. So, while other states were restricting access and passing hateful laws, **I vowed to fight like hell to protect our fundamental freedoms. You showed up in record numbers to fight like hell, too. And we won.** For years, the collective power of your support and commitment to action has transformed countless lives in Michigan and across the country. But there’s more work to do. subject: We cannot normalize the Israeli government’s war crimes against Palestinians.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last week, President Biden met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu,
whose far-right racist regime wants to eliminate Palestinians altogether.

And just this week, the Biden administration admitted Israel into the U.S.
Visa Waiver Program, which allows other countries’ citizens to visit here
without a visa if those countries also freely let in U.S. citizens.
However, Palestinian Americans and Arab Americans regularly face
discrimination when they try to travel to Israel and Palestine. I
experienced that when Israel’s government blocked me from entering to
visit my grandmother.

For calling out the Israeli government’s human rights abuses against
Palestinians and Palestinian Americans, I’ve faced attacks from
Republicans and Democrats who want to silence any criticism of Israel.
Their denial enables ongoing apartheid.

But I’m not backing down. So pro-apartheid AIPAC and its affiliated PACs
are gearing up to try to defeat me and other members of our Squad as we
run for re-election in 2024.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70488774/429494430/-1840601314?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.27_b2_KC_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjZmNzE3MC04YTVkLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mezN_4b7fYJwi6cL34WAZ0SrtzK2ktYWoW5GCNIrHbA=) Hi, Peter,

My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip.

[**I’m reaching out to you today to ask you to split a contribution today between my campaign and Emilia Sykes’ to help us end Kevin McCarthy’s chaos in Congress by flipping the House blue next year.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70488775/429494431/-1840601314?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.27_b2_KC_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjZmNzE3MC04YTVkLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mezN_4b7fYJwi6cL34WAZ0SrtzK2ktYWoW5GCNIrHbA=)

Here’s the bottom line: In order to become Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy sold out to the most extreme wing of his party. The result? GOP infighting. Extreme partisan rhetoric. Marjorie Taylor Greene calling the shots. **All the while, the American people are left behind.**

Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
The first end-of-quarter deadline of my campaign is in less than four days. We’re statistically tied with Rick Scott in a new poll, so we need to show strong fundraising numbers here to make sure he can’t pull ahead of us. But right now, we’re $32,119 short of my $350,000 goal.
That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a $5 donation to my campaign. But first, will you let me explain why I’m in this race? (If you’re ready to donate now, you can click here to split an end-of-quarter gift between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign.) [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]

I came to this country as a 14-year-old immigrant from Ecuador. My family lived in a one room apartment, and my mom worked double shifts to pay the bills. I got a job at the local doughnut shop to help her make ends meet.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/Screenshot%202023-09-27%20at%207.01.47%20PM.png]
I’ve seen firsthand just how difficult it is for working families to get by. But I’ve also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America.
I was able to attend college, give back to my community, and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. And, after years of long shifts and late night classes to learn English, my mom was able to retire with dignity thanks to Social Security and Medicare.
Make no mistake: There’s a lot of work that we have to do to make sure that every family has the chance to achieve their American Dream. That’s why I’m running for Senate — to protect and expand the opportunities that made my story possible.
I’m running against Rick Scott, who’s spent his career attacking those opportunities and threatening vital programs like Social Security and Medicare. He has a personal fortune of up to a quarter of a billion dollars to fund his campaign. That’s why I’m counting on a grassroots army made up of people like you to fight back.
Please, will you split $5 between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign before midnight tonight to help me hit my end-of-quarter goal and protect the opportunities that make the American Dream possible? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
Thank you,
Debbie

Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever.
While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 – and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority.
As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. So please, chip in to help defend our narrow Democratic Senate majority. Thank you,
Kirsten Gillibrand

Here’s a little reminder for Elon and every other racist, misogynistic person:

**Last night, Elon Musk said on Twitter, sorry ‘X’, that Alexandria is “just not that smart.”** Well, let’s take a look...

2. **Then Alexandria investigated Michael Cohen.** Alexandria’s questioning of Trump's former fixer and attorney on the Oversight Committee led to a $250 million lawsuit against Trump and his adult children.
3. **She authored a $2 billion FEMA program** — one of the largest programs in the agency’s history, in order to provide financial reimbursement to families who struggled to pay burial expenses for loved ones lost to COVID. She brought together community organizers in her district with Majority Leader Schumer to make the program a reality.

_Sounds pretty smart to us._ With your support, we’ve made transformative change — and ticked off more than a few billionaires along the way.

Florida deserves better, and we’ve got to fight for it. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend, [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
The first end-of-quarter deadline of my campaign is in less than four days. We’re statistically tied with Rick Scott in a new poll, so we need to show strong fundraising numbers here to make sure he can’t pull ahead of us. But right now, we’re $32,119 short of my $350,000 goal.
That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a $5 donation to my campaign. But first, will you let me explain why I’m in this race? (If you’re ready to donate now, you can click here to split an end-of-quarter gift between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign.) I came to this country as a 14-year-old immigrant from Ecuador. My family lived in a one room apartment, and my mom worked double shifts to pay the bills. I got a job at the local doughnut shop to help her make ends meet.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP19/1/72722/images/Screenshot%202023-09-27%20at%207.01.47%20PM.png]
I’ve seen firsthand just how difficult it is for working families to get by. But I’ve also seen the incredible opportunities that are only possible in America.
I was able to attend college, give back to my community, and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. And, after years of long shifts and late night classes to learn English, my mom was able to retire with dignity thanks to Social Security and Medicare.
Make no mistake: There’s a lot of work that we have to do to make sure that every family has the chance to achieve their American Dream. That’s why I’m running for Senate — to protect and expand the opportunities that made my story possible.
I’m running against Rick Scott, who’s spent his career attacking those opportunities and threatening vital programs like Social Security and Medicare. He has a personal fortune of up to a quarter of a billion dollars to fund his campaign. That’s why I’m counting on a grassroots army made up of people like you to fight back.
Please, will you split $5 between Kirsten Gillibrand and my campaign before midnight tonight to help me hit my end-of-quarter goal and protect the opportunities that make the American Dream possible? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
Thank you,
Debbie

As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now.
